lsp.query: Schließlich hätte ich gern gewusst, ob künftig noch Diskussionen mit dem Herrn Kommissar über eventuelle Einsatzszenarien möglich sind, denn jetzt reden wir theoretisch über Instrumente, wir müssen in Zukunft aber auch über die praktische Anwendung sprechen, und dafür dürfte eine Szenariendiskussion, so meine ich, überaus sinnvoll sein.
lsp.judge: Finally, I would like to know if there will be further discussions with the Commissioner about possible deployment scenarios in the future, because now we are theoretically talking about instruments, but in the future we also have to talk about practical application, and for that, a scenario discussion, as I believe, would be extremely useful.

lsp.query: Daher hätten wir eine umfassendere Finanzierung gewünscht, eine stärkere Koordinierung zur höheren Wirksamkeit der verschiedenen Programme, die angewendet werden können, sowie eine stärkere Mitverantwortung im Hinblick auf die spätere - manchmal leider notwendige - militärische Intervention, die möglicherweise nicht erforderlich wäre, wenn die vorangehenden Phasen realisiert würden.
lsp.judge: Therefore, we would have wished for more comprehensive financing, stronger coordination for greater effectiveness of the various programs that can be applied, and stronger shared responsibility regarding the later - sometimes unfortunately necessary - military intervention, which might not be necessary if the preceding phases were realized.

lsp.query: Bei allen Kontakten mit der Demokratischen Volksrepublik Korea hat die Union ihre überaus große Beunruhigung im Hinblick auf die schweren Menschenrechtsverletzungen in diesem Land betont. Das betrifft auch die Anzahl politischer Gefangener, das Fehlen einer nationalen Gesetzgebung sowie die Weigerung der koreanischen Behörden, gemäß den internationalen Mechanismen zum Schutz der Menschenrechte zusammenzuarbeiten.
lsp.judge: In all contacts with the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Union has emphasized its deep concern regarding the serious human rights violations in that country. This includes the number of political prisoners, the lack of national legislation, and the refusal of the Korean authorities to cooperate with international mechanisms for the protection of human rights.

lsp.query: Deshalb sage ich: Selbstverständlich fördern wir die Annäherung zwischen den beiden koreanischen Staaten, selbstverständlich unterstützen wir die Nordkoreaner, damit sie nicht hungers sterben - der Kollege Ford hat soeben davon gesprochen -, doch stellen wir hierfür harte Bedingungen, um zu gewährleisten, dass die Hilfe auch bei denjenigen, die sie wirklich benötigen, ankommt und wir nicht ein paranoides und unberechenbares Regime unterstützen, das daran gewöhnt ist, uns mit Nuklearwaffen und Raketen zu erpressen, um sein Überleben zu sichern.
lsp.judge: Therefore, I say: Of course, we promote rapprochement between the two Korean states, of course, we support the North Koreans so that they do not starve to death - as my colleague Ford just said - but we set hard conditions to ensure that the aid also reaches those who really need it and that we do not support a paranoid and unpredictable regime that is accustomed to blackmailing us with nuclear weapons and missiles to secure its survival.

lsp.query: Die Kommission als Hüterin der Verträge muss sich einerseits unnachgiebig gegenüber den Mitgliedstaaten zeigen, damit diese die Richtlinien einhalten, und andererseits muss sie sich den Bestrebungen zur Änderung dieser Texte widersetzen, bevor sie ihre volle Nützlichkeit unter Beweis stellen konnten, insbesondere in den Bereichen der Verunreinigung der Gewässer durch Nitrate sowie des Schutzes und der Aufwertung besonders wertvoller Naturräume.
lsp.judge: The Commission, as guardian of the treaties, must on the one hand be uncompromising towards the member states so that they comply with the guidelines, and on the other hand it must resist efforts to amend these texts before they have had the opportunity to demonstrate their full usefulness, particularly in the areas of water pollution by nitrates and the protection and enhancement of particularly valuable natural areas.
lsp.proxy: The Commission as guardian of the treaties must be unbending towards the Member States so that they comply with the directives, and at the same time, it must resist efforts to change these texts before they have demonstrated their full effectiveness, especially in the areas of water pollution by nitrates and the protection and enhancement of particularly valuable natural habitats.
lsp.reference: The Commission as guardian of the treaties must show itself to be uncompromising towards the member states on the one hand, so that they adhere to the guidelines, and on the other hand, it must resist the efforts to change these texts before they have proven their full usefulness, especially in the areas of water pollution by nitrates and the protection and enhancement of particularly valuable natural areas.

lsp.query: Wir müssen, auch in der Welthandelsorganisation, die Ursprungsbezeichnungen unserer Qualitätsprodukte, u. a. des Weins, verteidigen und sichern, denn unsere Zukunft in der EU und was den Export in Drittländer betrifft, liegt in Produkten hochwertiger Qualität, für die es bei uns, und auch in der Welt, zahlungskräftige und mündige Verbraucher gibt.
lsp.judge: We must defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, even within the World Trade Organization, because our future in the EU and in terms of exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are affluent and discerning consumers both here and worldwide.
lsp.proxy: We must defend and secure the origin designations of our quality products, including wine, in the World Trade Organization, as our future in the EU and for exports to third countries lies in high-quality products for which there are financially sound and discerning consumers both here and around the world.
lsp.reference: We must, also within the World Trade Organization, defend and secure the origin designations of our high-quality products, including wine, as our future in the EU and with regard to exports to third countries depends on products of superior quality, for which there are price-paying and informed consumers both at home and around the world.

lsp.query: Die Kommission führt folgende Prioritäten auf: verbesserte Kohärenz zwischen den verschiedenen Zielen, die die GFP verfolgt, insbesondere zwischen Erhaltung der Ressourcen, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Arbeitsplatzsicherung in den von der Fischerei abhängigen Gebieten; stärkere Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen Dimension des Fischereisektors; verbesserte Integration der Umwelt- und Fischereipolitik; Verbesserung der Bewirtschaftungsinstrumente, wie insbesondere die Einbeziehung der mehrjährigen Bewirtschaftungsziele; ein übersichtlicherer Entscheidungsfindungsprozess und die Erhaltung der externen Dimension der GFP.
lsp.judge: The Commission identifies the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the CFP, in particular between resource conservation, economic viability and job security in fishing-dependent areas; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fishing sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, in particular the inclusion of multiannual management objectives; a clearer decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the CFP.
lsp.proxy: The Commission lists the following priorities: improved coherence between the various goals pursued by the GFP, especially between resource conservation, economic viability, and job security in fishing-dependent areas; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fisheries sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policies; better management tools, particularly the inclusion of multi-year management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process; and the maintenance of the external dimension of the GFP.
lsp.reference: The Commission sets the following priorities: improved coherence between the various objectives pursued by the GFP, in particular between the conservation of resources, economic viability and job security in the areas dependent on fishing; stronger consideration of the economic dimension of the fishing sector; improved integration of environmental and fisheries policy; improvement of management instruments, including in particular the inclusion of multi-annual management objectives; a more transparent decision-making process and the preservation of the external dimension of the GFP.

lsp.query: Der gemeinsame Entschließungsantrag bestreitet den eindeutigen Zusammenhang zwischen der Verwendung von abgereichertem Uran und dem Auftreten von Krebs und Leukämie bei Soldaten, die an den Besatzungskräften in Bosnien und im Kosovo, aber auch am Golf-Krieg beteiligt gewesen sind. Er beschränkt sich auf den frommen Wunsch nach "einer offenen und transparenten Debatte " sowie nach Einsetzung einer Arbeitsgruppe und fordert "die Mitgliedstaaten, die auch der NATO angehören, auf, ein Moratorium für die Verwendung von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran...vorzuschlagen ", während von der ÍÁÔÏ lediglich verlangt wird, "den Einsatz anderer Munitionstypen in Erwägung zu ziehen ", d. h. sie kann zwar weiterhin töten, aber mit "sauberen " Waffen.
lsp.judge: The joint resolution proposal disputes the clear link between the use of depleted uranium and the occurrence of cancer and leukemia in soldiers who participated in the occupation forces in Bosnia and Kosovo, but also in the Gulf War. It limits itself to the pious wish for "an open and transparent debate" as well as the establishment of a working group and calls on "the member states, which also belong to NATO, to propose a moratorium on the use of ammunition with depleted uranium...", while the IAEA is only asked to "consider the use of other types of ammunition", i.e. it can continue to kill, but with "clean" weapons.
lsp.proxy: The common resolution denies the clear connection between the use of depleted uranium and the occurrence of cancer and leukemia among soldiers involved in the occupation forces in Bosnia and Kosovo, as well as in the Gulf War. It restricts itself to the pious wish for "an open and transparent debate" as well as the establishment of a working group and demands that "Member States, which are also part of NATO, propose a moratorium on the use of ammunition with depleted uranium...". Meanwhile, it merely requests that the "use of other types of ammunition be considered", meaning that they can still kill, but with "clean" weapons.
lsp.reference: The joint resolution motion denies an evident link between the use of depleted uranium and the occurrence of cancer and leukemia among soldiers who were involved in the peacekeeping forces in Bosnia and Kosovo, as well as in the Gulf War. It confines itself to the pious wish for "an open and transparent debate" as well as the establishment of a working group and demands "that member states, which also belong to NATO, suggest a moratorium on the use of ammunition with depleted uranium...," while the EU merely requires "to consider the use of other types of ammunition," i.e., it can still kill, but with "clean" weapons.

lsp.query: . (FR) Dass den Armeen der größten Mächte seit zehn Jahren die Schädlichkeit von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran, auch für diejenigen, die sie einsetzen, bekannt ist, beweist nur, dass die Generalstäbe ihren eigenen Soldaten die gleiche Missachtung entgegenbringen wie der Zivilbevölkerung und den gegnerischen Streitkräften.
lsp.judge: That the armies of the greatest powers have known for ten years the harmfulness of depleted uranium munitions, even for those who use them, proves only that the general staffs show their own soldiers the same disregard as they do for the civilian population and the enemy forces.
lsp.proxy: The fact that the armies of the great powers have known for ten years about the harmfulness of ammunition containing depleted uranium, not just for those who use it, proves that the general staffs treat their own soldiers with the same disregard as they do the civilian population and the opposing forces.
lsp.reference: That the armies of the greatest powers have known for ten years the harmfulness of uranium-tipped ammunition, even for those who use it, proves only that the general staffs show the same contempt to their own soldiers as to the civilian population and the opposing forces.

lsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
lsp.judge: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautions associated with handling uranium and other radioactive materials have been well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element if inhaled or absorbed, and it is also genetically dangerous.
lsp.proxy: Since the beginning of the atomic age, starting with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances are well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that can be hazardous to genetic material if inhaled or ingested.
lsp.reference: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and preventive measures are well known that one must observe when handling uranium and other radioactive substances, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, nach all den tragischen Geschehnissen im Zusammenhang mit der Bombardierung Jugoslawiens und nach den Enthüllungen über die Verwendung von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran ist es nunmehr dringend erforderlich, diese Art von Waffen zu verbieten, die selbst nach ihrem Einsatz noch über eine lange Zeit hinweg gefährliche Auswirkungen haben und blind, d. h. ohne erkennbaren Unterschied, all diejenigen treffen können, die Gefahr laufen, mit ihnen in Berührung zu kommen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, after all the tragic events in connection with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium munitions, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which even after its use continues to have dangerous effects for a long time and indiscriminately, i.e. without any recognizable distinction, affects all those who are at risk of coming into contact with it.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, following all the tragic events in connection with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of munitions with depleted uranium, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which continues to have dangerous effects for a long time after its use and can affect indiscriminately, that is, without any discernible distinction, all those who are at risk of coming into contact with them.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, in light of the tragic events surrounding the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium ammunition, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which, even after its use, has hazardous effects for a long time and can, blind, i.e., without discernible distinction, affect all those who run the risk of coming into contact with them.

lsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich meine Ratlosigkeit angesichts der politischen Kehrtwende zum Ausdruck bringen, die bei unserer Aussprache zutage getreten ist. Während uns seinerzeit einige vorhielten, unsere Kritik an Milosevics Politik diene der NATO und ihren Bombardements, wirft uns Herr Solana heute vor, wir würden bei unseren Vorbehalten gegenüber dem abgereicherten Uran die Menschenrechte der Opfer von Milosevic vergessen.
lsp.judge: Finally, I would like to express my bewilderment at the political about-face that has emerged during our discussion. While some people accused us at the time of using our criticism of Milosevic's policies to serve NATO and its bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic in our reservations about depleted uranium.
lsp.proxy: In conclusion, I want to express my helplessness regarding the political about-face that has become apparent during our discussion. While some had previously argued that our criticism of Milosevic's politics served the NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic when we harbor reservations about depleted uranium.
lsp.reference: In conclusion, I would like to express my bewilderment in the face of the political U-turn that has become apparent in our discussion. While some of us were accused at the time of using our criticism of Milosevic's policy to serve the interests of NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic in our reservations about the enriched uranium.

lsp.query: Ich habe im letzten Jahr außerdem mit Sorge beobachtet, dass die derzeitige russische Führung - zu der viele ehemalige KGB-Mitarbeiter gehören, die von Präsident Putin, der ja früher selbst KGB-Oberst war, berufen wurden - großen Eifer bei der Verhaftung so genannter britischer, amerikanischer und russischer Spione an den Tag gelegt hat.
lsp.judge: Last year, I also observed with concern that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB officers appointed by President Putin, who himself was formerly a KGB colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
lsp.proxy: In the past year, I have also observed with concern that the current Russian leadership - many of whom are former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who himself used to be a KGB Colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
lsp.reference: I have also been observing with concern in the past year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees who were appointed by President Putin, who was himself a KGB colonel in the past - has shown great zeal in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.

lsp.query: Ich sage das eingedenk des Völkermords in Ruanda im Jahre 1994, wo die Völkergemeinschaft mit ansehen musste, wie Hunderttausende Menschen ermordet wurden. Im Hinblick auf Zentralafrika möchte ich darauf drängen, dass die Europäische Union energischer handelt und auch die Vereinten Nationen größere Wachsamkeit zeigen.
lsp.judge: I say this in remembrance of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. With regard to Central Africa, I would like to urge the European Union to act more decisively and for the United Nations to show greater vigilance.
lsp.proxy: I say this in remembrance of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. Regarding Central Africa, I urge that the European Union take more decisive action and that the United Nations also show greater vigilance.
lsp.reference: I say this mindful of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to witness the murder of hundreds of thousands of people. In light of Central Africa, I would like to urge that the European Union takes more decisive action and that the United Nations displays greater vigilance.

lsp.query: In Bezug auf die Entwicklungsländer sind wir daher gezwungen, für die Sanktionen eine besondere Strategie zu entwickeln, so dass nicht nur diejenigen betroffen sind, denen wir eigentlich helfen wollten und die bereits vorher leiden mussten.
lsp.judge: Therefore, with regard to developing countries, we are forced to develop a special strategy for sanctions so that not only those are affected who we actually wanted to help and who were already suffering beforehand.
lsp.proxy: Regarding the developing countries, we are therefore forced to develop a special strategy for the sanctions so that not only those are affected who were actually meant to benefit and who were already suffering beforehand.
lsp.reference: In relation to developing countries, we are therefore forced to develop a special strategy for the sanctions, so that not only those who we actually wanted to help are affected, but also those who have already suffered beforehand.

lsp.query: (Beifall) Zweitens: Wir fordern Sie auf, schon ziemlich schnell - die Vorbereitungen müssen unter Ihrer Präsidentschaft beginnen und sollten dann in Laken unter belgischer Präsidentschaft zu einem Beschluss führen - eine Konferenz einzusetzen, die sich an der Methodik und an dem Modell des Konventes orientiert, unter starker Beteiligung des Europäischen Parlaments und natürlich der nationalen Regierungen, vor allen Dingen aber auch der Kommission.
lsp.judge: (Applause) Secondly: We call on you to convene a conference fairly soon - the preparations must begin under your presidency and should then, under Belgian presidency, lead to a decision - a conference that is oriented towards the methodology and model of the Convention, with strong involvement of the European Parliament and of course the national governments, but above all also the Commission.
lsp.proxy: (Applause) Second: We urge you to start making preparations quite swiftly – these must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Laeken under the Belgian presidency – by convening a conference that is oriented towards the method and model of the Convention, with strong involvement of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, but especially also of the Commission.
lsp.reference: (Applause) Secondly, we call on you to start preparations quite quickly - under your presidency, they should lead to a decision in Laken under Belgian presidency - to convene a conference that is oriented towards the methodology and model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, above all, however, also the Commission.

lsp.query: In einer ersten Phase müsste parallel zu der unter schwedischer Präsidentschaft begonnenen Diskussion auf Einladung des Europäischen Rates - und zwar frühestmöglich - eine Diskussion und Meinungsbildung auf der Ebene der nationalen Parlamente stattfinden, die dann ebenso wie das Europäische Parlament jeweils bis etwa Frühjahr 2002 einen Vorschlag hinsichtlich dieser Kompetenzabgrenzung vorlegen müssten.
lsp.judge: In a first phase, a discussion and opinion-forming process should take place at the level of national parliaments in parallel to the discussion initiated under Swedish presidency at the invitation of the European Council - and as early as possible. Both the national parliaments and the European Parliament should then submit a proposal regarding this delimitation of competences by approximately spring 2002.
lsp.proxy: In the first phase, parallel to the discussion initiated by the Swedish Presidency at the invitation of the European Council - and as soon as possible - a discussion and opinion-forming process should take place at the level of national parliaments, which would then, like the European Parliament, have to present proposals regarding this competence delimitation by early spring 2002.
lsp.reference: In an initial phase, a discussion and opinion-forming process should take place at the level of national parliaments, parallel to the ongoing discussion under Swedish presidency, which was initiated by the European Council - as soon as possible. Each national parliament, as well as the European Parliament, would then have to submit a proposal regarding this competence division by approximately spring 2002.

lsp.query: Ebenso wie einige andere Redner des heutigen Tages bin auch ich beunruhigt über die Tendenz, das zwischenstaatliche Modell oft und nachdrücklich auf Kosten des so genannten Community Approach hervorzuheben, der der Kommission eine stärkere Rolle und Bedeutung zuweist.
lsp.judge: Just like some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to emphasize the inter-state model often and strongly at the expense of the so-called Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and importance to the Commission.
lsp.proxy: Similarly to some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically highlight the intergovernmental model at the expense of what is known as the Community Approach, which assigns the Commission a stronger role and significance.
lsp.reference: Just like some other speakers of today, I am also concerned about the trend of often and emphatically highlighting the inter-state model at the expense of what is called the Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and significance to the Commission.

lsp.query: Wenn es Ihnen gelingt, Ihre Landsleute davon zu überzeugen, dass der Euro ein gutes Projekt ist, dass er nach innen stabil ist, dass seine Stabilität nach außen auch immer besser wird, wenn Sie sie davon überzeugen können, dieses große Werk der europäischen Integration mitzutragen, tragen Sie damit auch dazu bei, dass dieser Bereich der Europäischen Union auch von den Bürgern besser verstanden werden kann.
lsp.judge: If you succeed in convincing your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its external stability is also constantly improving, if you can convince them to contribute to this great project of European integration, you will also be contributing to the fact that this area of the European Union is better understood by its citizens.
lsp.proxy: If you manage to convince your fellow citizens that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, and that its stability is getting better externally over time, and if you can persuade them to contribute to this great work of European integration, then you will also help to ensure that this area of the European Union is better understood by its citizens.
lsp.reference: If you succeed in convincing your fellow countrymen that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its stability will also improve externally, and if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also contribute to the fact that this area of the European Union can be better understood by its citizens.

lsp.query: Gleichzeitig verkündet der Europarat, dass die Folter weiterhin in den Polizeirevieren der Türkei an der Tagesordnung ist, und Amnesty International verurteilt die Folter, die Nichtbestrafung der Verantwortlichen und generell die Verstöße gegen die Menschenrechte seitens der Türkei und fordert die Europäische Union auf, zu verlangen, dass die Folter unverzüglich eingestellt wird, und nicht erst 2002­2003, wie in dem Verfahren für den Beitritt der Türkei zur Europäischen Union vorgesehen.
lsp.judge: At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture continues to be commonplace in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, and calls on the European Union to demand that torture be stopped immediately, and not in 2002-2003, as foreseen in the procedure for Turkey's accession to the European Union.
lsp.proxy: Simultaneously, the Council of Europe announces that torture continues to be practiced in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, calling on the European Union to demand an immediate end to torture, rather than in 2002-2003 as planned in the accession process for Turkey's membership in the European Union.
lsp.reference:
# English
At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still on the agenda in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the non-prosecution of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, and demands that the European Union call for torture to be immediately stopped, and not just in 2002-2003, as provided for in the accession procedure for Turkey's entry into the European Union.

lsp.query: Nach der Tagesordnung folgt der Bericht (A5-0393/2000) von Herrn Simpson im Namen des Ausschusses für Regionalpolitik, Verkehr und Fremdenverkehr über den Vorschlag für eine Verordnung des Europäischen Parlaments und des Rates zur Änderung der Verordnung (EWG) Nr. 3922/91 des Rates zur Harmonisierung der technischen Vorschriften und der Verwaltungsverfahren in der Zivilluftfahrt.

lsp.query: Deshalb sage ich auch sehr deutlich: So sehr wir in weiten Teilen Ihrem Bericht zustimmen können, halten wir es nicht für angemessen, dass das Parlament in bestimmten Bereichen - Stichwort "alleiniger Flugbegleiter " oder die Dauer der Beschäftigung, also wie lange jemand bereits als Flugbegleiter tätig ist - eigene detaillierte Grundlagen in diese Verordnung einsetzt.
lsp.judge: Therefore, I also say very clearly: As much as we can agree with many parts of your report, we do not consider it appropriate for Parliament to set its own detailed guidelines in this regulation in certain areas - for example, "sole flight attendant" or the length of employment, i.e. how long someone has already been working as a flight attendant.
lsp.proxy: That is why I also state very clearly: While we can agree with much of your report, we do not consider it appropriate for the Parliament to set its own detailed grounds in certain areas - such as the term "sole flight attendant" or the duration of employment, i.e., how long someone has already been working as a flight attendant - into this regulation.
lsp.reference: Therefore, I say very clearly: As much as we can agree with your report in many parts, we do not consider it appropriate that the parliament introduces its own detailed foundations in certain areas - the term "sole flight attendant" or the duration of employment, i.e., how long someone has already been working as a flight attendant - into this regulation.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson, Frau Kommissarin! Nachdem ich soeben die Nachrichten gesehen hatte, hoffte ich - und eigentlich sah es auch fast danach aus -, wir würden eine Aussprache über fox hunting führen, worüber es heute Abend zweifellos eine äußerst lebhafte Debatte im britischen Parlament geben wird.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Commissioner! After I had just seen the news, I hoped - and actually it almost looked that way - that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly be the subject of a very lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Mrs. Commissioner! After just watching the news, I hoped – and it actually seemed that way – that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly lead to a very lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Commissioner! After I had just seen the news, I had hoped - and it actually seemed almost like it - that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly lead to a very lively debate in the British Parliament tonight.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson hat wirklich einen ausgezeichneten Bericht vorgelegt. Ich kann das behaupten, weil ich wohl zu den wenigen gehöre, die nicht nur politisch, sondern auch fachlich mit diesem Sektor vertraut sind, denn bevor ich mich meiner Tätigkeit als Abgeordneter dieses Parlaments zuwandte, hatte ich etwa 10 000 Flugstunden als Mitglied einer Cockpitbesatzung absolviert.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has indeed presented an excellent report. I can say that because I am probably one of the few who are familiar with this sector not only politically but also professionally, because before I turned to my work as a Member of this Parliament, I had completed about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.
lsp.proxy: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has indeed presented an excellent report. I can say this because I am one of the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, as before I devoted myself to my work as a Member of this Parliament, I had accumulated approximately 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has really presented an excellent report. I can say that because I probably belong to the few who are not only politically but also professionally familiar with this sector, because before I turned to my activity as a member of this parliament, I had about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.

lsp.query: Ich weise Sie darauf hin, dass die Sicherheit das A und O des Luftverkehrs ist, wobei zu beachten ist, dass diese Sicherheit auf zwei Faktoren beruht: zum einen auf dem technischen Faktor, das heißt den Ausrüstungen, Flugzeugen, Flughäfen, Funknavigations- und Flugleiteinrichtungen usw., und zum anderen auf dem äußerst bedeutsamen menschlichen Faktor, der zwar keinen entscheidenden, aber doch einen sehr hohen Anteil an den Flugzeugunglücken hat.
lsp.judge: I would like to point out that safety is paramount in air travel, and this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, namely the equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, while not decisive, still plays a very significant role in aviation accidents.
lsp.proxy: I draw your attention to the fact that safety is the paramount concern in air traffic, with two factors being crucial for this safety: on one hand, the technical factor, which includes equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although not decisive, still plays a very high role in aircraft accidents.
lsp.reference: I would like to draw your attention to the fact that safety is the A and O of air traffic, where it is worth noting that this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, that is to say the equipment, aircraft, airports, navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although it does not have a decisive share, yet has a very high share in aircraft accidents.

lsp.query: Entweder einigen sich die Parteien bis zum Mai, oder wir erwarten, dass die Kommission einen Vorschlag macht, den wir in die zweite Lesung einbauen können, denn es geht nicht an, dass die entscheidende Frage für die Sicherheit der Passagiere, nämlich, ob die Kapitäne, die Besatzungen, so ausgeruht sind, dass sie ihre Aufgaben wahrnehmen können, nicht geregelt wird.
lsp.judge: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is unacceptable that the crucial question of passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crews are sufficiently rested to perform their duties, remains unresolved.

lsp.query: Davon ausgehend verfolgt die von uns vorgeschlagene Änderung zur bestehenden Verordnung ein zweifaches Ziel: Zum einen zielt sie auf die weitere Harmonisierung des Regulierungssystems im Bereich der Sicherheit der Zivilluftfahrt durch seine Ausdehnung auf die Harmonisierung der Betriebsanforderungen für Luftfahrzeuge; zum anderen geht es um die Festlegung von Verfahren, die es der Gemeinschaft ermöglichen, die Varianten und die Ausnahmen zu bearbeiten, die die Mitgliedstaaten hin und wieder aus operativen Erfordernissen anwenden müssen.
lsp.judge: Based on this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation aims at two objectives: firstly, it aims to further harmonize the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to harmonize the operational requirements for aircraft; secondly, it is about establishing procedures that enable the Community to handle the variations and exemptions that Member States occasionally have to apply for operational reasons.
lsp.proxy: Based on this, our proposed amendment to the existing regulation aims at achieving a dual objective: on the one hand, it seeks to further harmonize the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to include the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it focuses on establishing procedures that will enable the community to address the variations and exceptions that member states must occasionally apply due to operational necessities.
lsp.reference:
# English
Starting from this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonization of the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety through its extension to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the community to handle the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply from operational requirements.

lsp.query: Hinsichtlich des konkreten Problems der Thrombose - die jemand von Ihnen angesprochen hat - hat die Kommission die Luftverkehrsgesellschaften schriftlich aufgefordert, die Fluggäste über die Gefahren, Prädispositionsfaktoren und die Maßnahmen zur Minimierung dieser Risiken, konkret im Zusammenhang mit der Thrombose und den gesundheitlichen Problemen im Allgemeinen zu informieren.
lsp.judge: Regarding the specific problem of thrombosis - which someone of you has raised - the Commission has written to the airlines, asking them to inform passengers about the dangers, predisposing factors, and measures to minimize these risks, specifically in connection with thrombosis and general health problems.

lsp.query: Aus diesem Grunde bedaure ich auch außerordentlich, dass der Änderungsantrag zur Harmonisierung der Wiederzulassung verunfallter Fahrzeuge in der Europäischen Union nicht angenommen wurde, obwohl unabhängige Gutachten eindeutig einen substantiellen Zusammenhang zwischen einmal verunfallten Fahrzeugen und erneuter Teilhabe an Unfällen mit erhöhter Todesfolge beweisen.
lsp.judge: For this reason, I also deeply regret that the amendment to harmonize the re-registration of accident-damaged vehicles in the European Union was not adopted, although independent expert opinions clearly demonstrate a substantial link between vehicles that have been in an accident once and their increased involvement in subsequent accidents with higher fatality rates.

lsp.query: Zum einen würde kein EU-Staat akzeptieren, wenn ein anderer Mitgliedstaat tolerieren würde, dass ein Flugkapitän in einem Flugzeug mit 300 Passagieren, ein Kapitän zur See, der für die Sicherheit von 1 000 Personen verantwortlich ist, oder ein Lokführer Alkohol trinken würde, bevor er die Verantwortung für seine Passagiere übernimmt.
lsp.judge: On the one hand, no EU state would accept it if another member state tolerated a pilot in an airplane with 300 passengers, a captain at sea responsible for the safety of 1,000 people, or a train driver drinking alcohol before taking responsibility for their passengers.

lsp.query: Analysiert man die Reibungskosten im intermodalen Güterverkehr im Einzelnen, so ist festzustellen, dass die Hauptproblempunkte gegenüber dem traditionellen unimodalen Verkehr in höheren Preisen, längeren Fahrzeiten, zunehmenden von den Gütern zurückgelegten durchschnittlichen Entfernungen, Qualitätsminderung, größeren Beschädigungsrisiken, Beschränkungen bezüglich der Art der beförderten Güter sowie komplexeren Verwaltungsverfahren liegen.
lsp.judge: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail reveals that the main problem points compared to traditional unimodal transport are higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by goods, quality deterioration, higher damage risks, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
lsp.proxy: When analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it becomes apparent that the main issues compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer transit times, increased average distances traveled by the goods, quality degradation, greater risk of damage, limitations regarding the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
lsp.reference: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be determined that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, quality degradation, greater damage risks, restrictions on the type of goods being transported, and more complex administrative procedures.

lsp.query: Schließlich kennzeichnet eine Reihe von Hindernissen, verursacht durch mangelnde Harmonisierung der Fristen und Zeitpläne zwischen den einzelnen Verkehrsträgern, das gesamte System, wodurch es zu Unvereinbarkeiten zwischen den mit der Gütertransportkette verknüpften Erfordernissen und den operativen Erfordernissen der im Prozess eingesetzten Ressourcen kommt: So sind beispielsweise die Arbeitszeiten der Fahrer und Besatzungen nicht auf die intermodalen Operationen abgestimmt und die Terminals können sich nicht immer den auf einem 24-Stunden-Dienst beruhenden Zug- und Schiffsplänen anpassen.
lsp.judge: Finally, a number of obstacles, caused by a lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between the individual modes of transport, characterize the entire system, leading to inconsistencies between the requirements associated with the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not aligned with intermodal operations and terminals cannot always adapt to the train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.

lsp.reference:
# English

In the end, a series of obstacles, caused by a lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between individual modes of transport, characterizes the entire system, resulting in incompatibilities between the requirements linked to the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not adjusted to intermodal operations and terminals cannot always adapt to train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.

lsp.query: In ihrem Bericht "Intermodalität und intermodaler Güterverkehr in der Europäischen Union " hatte die Kommission die im intermodalen Verkehr zu erreichenden Ziele aufgezeigt und sie entsprechend der spezifischen Probleme in drei vorrangige Interventionsbereiche, so genannte Schlüsselaktionen unterteilt. Die erste Schlüsselaktion betrifft die Integration von Infrastruktur und Transportmitteln, die zweite die Interoperabilität und den Verbundbetrieb und die dritte die verkehrsträgerunabhängigen Dienste und Vorschriften.
lsp.judge: In her report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union," the Commission outlined the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and, in line with the specific problems, divided them into three priority intervention areas, so-called key actions. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second interoperability and combined operation, and the third transport-mode-independent services and regulations.
lsp.proxy: In her report "Intermodality and Intermodal Goods Traffic in the European Union," the Commission outlined the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority intervention areas, known as key actions, according to the specific problems at hand. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second addresses interoperability and coupled operation, and the third focuses on mode-independent services and regulations.
lsp.reference: In their report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union", the Commission had shown the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and divided them into three priority intervention areas, so-called key actions, corresponding to the specific problems. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second the interoperability and the combined operation, and the third the transport mode-independent services and regulations.

lsp.query: Die Kommissionsmitteilung und der Bericht haben viele, ja alle wichtigen Problempunkte zur Sprache gebracht. Die Revisionen der transeuropäischen Netze hin zu einem wirklich intermodalen Netz, Maßnahmen zur Schaffung eines Logistikmehrwertes, Harmonisierungen, die noch nötig sind bei Ladeeinheiten und anderem mehr, wirklich intermodale Informationen, standardisierte Meldungen und Dokumente, Förderung von intermodalen Haftungsregeln und vieles andere mehr.
lsp.judge: The Commission communication and the report have addressed many, indeed all, of the important problem points. The revisions of the trans-European networks towards a truly intermodal network, measures to create added value in logistics, harmonizations that are still needed for loading units and more, truly intermodal information, standardized reports and documents, promotion of intermodal liability rules and much more.

lsp.query: Zur Frage der Intermodalität bei der Überquerung der Alpen ist festzustellen, dass, abgesehen von der Entscheidung der Schweiz zugunsten erheblicher Investitionen im Eisenbahnsektor, ein Besorgnis erregender Rückstand beim Bau der anderen Verkehrsachsen und neuen Eisenbahntunnel besteht, die bereits von der Gemeinschaft geplant wurden, wie die Achse Turin-Lyon-Brenner, oder in der Diskussion sind, wie die Achse Aosta-Martigny.
lsp.judge: Regarding the issue of intermodality for crossing the Alps, it must be stated that, apart from Switzerland's decision in favor of significant investments in the rail sector, there is a worrying backlog in the construction of other transport axes and new railway tunnels that have already been planned by the community, such as the Turin-Lyon-Brenner axis, or are under discussion, such as the Aosta-Martigny axis.

lsp.query: Der Beitrag, den wir somit leisten, hat zwei Konsequenzen, die ich hier hervorheben möchte: Erstens werden wir, wenn wir dank der Methodik, die wir hoffentlich von der Kommission vorgelegt bekommen und akzeptieren können, eine klarere Definition und Anlastung der internen und externen Kosten an die Nutzer erreichen, die Voraussetzungen dafür schaffen, die Finanzierung der Infrastruktur, die gegenwärtig durch die öffentliche Hand gesichert wird bzw. über die allgemeine Besteuerung erfolgt, auf die Benutzer als solche zu verlagern.
lsp.judge: The contribution we thus make has two consequences, which I would like to highlight here: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology, which we hopefully will receive and be able to accept from the Commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of internal and external costs to the users, we will create the prerequisites for shifting the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public sector or through general taxation, to the users themselves.
lsp.proxy: The contribution we thus make has two consequences that I would like to highlight: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology that we hope to receive and accept from the Commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of both internal and external costs to users, we will create the prerequisites for shifting the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public sector or through general taxation, onto users themselves.
lsp.reference: The contribution we make in this way has two consequences that I would like to highlight here: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology that we hopefully receive and can accept from the commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of internal and external costs to the users, we create the conditions to transfer the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public hand or takes place through general taxation, to the users as such.

lsp.query: Ich verweise hier auf ein Schreiben der Organisation, welche die Automobilclubs, wie zum Beispiel den AA und den RAC, in ganz Europa repräsentiert, und unsere Arbeit sehr begrüßt und unterstützt. Grund für diese Unterstützung ist die Erkenntnis, dass Europa hier mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen muss und wir die besten Konzepte aus der gesamten Europäischen Union zusammentragen müssen, weil andernfalls die Großstädte, die Städte und ländlichen Gebiete auch weiterhin unter unzumutbaren Verkehrsstaus und einer unerträglichen Umweltverschmutzung zu leiden haben werden.

lsp.query: Wenn mir ein gewisser Vergleich mit der Diskussion erlaubt ist, die vor dem Hintergrund der Probleme im Zusammenhang mit der Nahrungsmittelsicherheit über die Reform der Agrarpolitik gegenwärtig nicht nur in Deutschland, sondern auch in einigen weiteren Mitgliedstaaten - mein Land zählt dazu - geführt wird, so prophezeie ich Ihnen angesichts der heutigen Umweltprobleme - trotz gescheiterter Klimakonferenzen - eine ähnliche Situation auch im Bereich der Verkehrspolitik.
lsp.judge: If a certain comparison with the discussion, which is currently taking place against the background of the problems associated with food security, regarding the reform of agricultural policy, is permitted, not only in Germany but also in some other member states - my country included - then I predict, in light of today's environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences - a similar situation also in the field of transport policy.

lsp.query: Um es nicht dazu kommen zu lassen, darf unser Ziel nicht darin bestehen, die Verkehrsinfrastrukturkosten zu minimieren, um somit möglichst wenig Kosten anzulasten, sondern wir müssen den Verkehrsbetreibern eine entsprechende Rechtsgrundlage bieten, damit sie die verursachten Kosten der Gruppe anlasten können, die dafür aufzukommen haben, nämlich den Endnutzern.
lsp.judge: In order to prevent this from happening, our goal should not be to minimize transportation infrastructure costs in order to impose as few costs as possible, but we must provide transport operators with the appropriate legal basis so that they can charge the costs incurred to the group responsible for them, namely the end users.
lsp.proxy: To prevent this from happening, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs in order to shift as little cost as possible, but we must provide traffic operators with the appropriate legal basis so that they can pass on the costs incurred to the group responsible for bearing them, namely the end users.
lsp.reference: In order to prevent this from happening, our goal must not be to minimize traffic infrastructure costs so as to assign as few costs as possible, but rather we must provide the operators of the traffic with a corresponding legal basis, so that they can assign the costs caused by the group that is responsible for them, namely the end-users.

lsp.query: Ich möchte die von uns allen mitgetragenen Schwerpunkte noch einmal nennen: Kostenaufteilung in einem direkteren Verhältnis zur Nutzung der Infrastrukturen; Berücksichtigung der sozialen Kosten, aber auch Schutz benachteiligter Gebiete und Bevölkerungsgruppen; Förderung der Umweltverträglichkeit, aber gleichzeitig auch Durchsetzung des Rechts auf Mobilität als Universalrecht.
lsp.judge: I would like to reiterate the key points that we have all agreed on: cost allocation in a more direct relationship to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, but at the same time enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.

lsp.query: Heute befinden sich die Beschäftigten des Unternehmens, zumindest in Frankreich, im Streik, und ich möchte in Erwartung Ihrer Antwort hinsichtlich des Ausschusses diesen Arbeitnehmern unsere Solidarität bekunden, denn es ist eine Schande, dass ein Konzern, der Milliarden Gewinne macht, Tausende von Arbeitnehmern in ganz Europa in die Arbeitslosigkeit und ins Elend schickt.
lsp.judge: Today, employees of the company, at least in France, are on strike, and in anticipation of your response regarding the committee, I would like to express our solidarity with these workers, because it is a disgrace that a corporation that makes billions in profit sends thousands of workers across Europe into unemployment and poverty.

lsp.query: Die soziale Infrastruktur zur Seniorenbetreuung ist auszubauen, und schließlich müssen die Mitgliedstaaten bei der nächsten Regierungskonferenz den Vertrag dahingehend ändern, dass eine solide gesetzliche Basis geschaffen wird, die eine ausgewogene Mitwirkung beider Geschlechter in den institutionellen Organen der Europäischen Union sicherstellt, damit endlich das Selbstverständliche Realität wird, also das natürliche Gleichgewicht der Geschlechter auch in den Machtzentren seinen Niederschlag findet und jedwede die Zukunft Europas betreffenden Entscheidungen nicht ohne Einbeziehung der Frauen gefällt werden.
lsp.judge: The social infrastructure for senior care needs to be expanded, and ultimately, the member states must change the treaty at the next government conference so that a solid legal basis is created that ensures balanced participation of both genders in the institutional organs of the European Union, so that the self-evident becomes a reality, namely that the natural gender balance also finds its expression in the centers of power, and that any decisions concerning the future of Europe are not made without the involvement of women.
lsp.proxy: The social infrastructure for senior care needs to be expanded, and ultimately, the member states must change the treaty at the next intergovernmental conference to create a solid legal basis that ensures balanced gender representation in the institutional bodies of the European Union, so that finally, the natural balance of genders also finds expression in the centers of power, and any decisions concerning the future of Europe are not made without including women.
lsp.reference: The social infrastructure for senior care needs to be expanded, and ultimately, the member states must change the treaty at the next government conference in such a way that a solid legal basis is created, which ensures balanced participation of both sexes in the institutional organs of the European Union, so that finally the self-evident becomes a reality, namely the natural balance of the sexes also finds its expression in the power centers, and any decisions concerning the future of Europe are not made without the involvement of women.

lsp.query: Frau Karamanou, ich glaube nicht, dass die schwache Vertretung der Frauen oder auch der Jugendlichen in unseren Parlamenten auf ein Übermaß an Demokratie zurückzuführen ist, sondern auf ein Demokratiedefizit, und die Wahllisten, die von den Parteien aufgestellt werden - die sogar, wie Sie es in Ihrem Bericht empfehlen, als Listen mit einer Quotenregelung aufgestellt werden, wo es nicht einmal mehr möglich ist, eine Vorzugsstimme abzugeben - bilden ein hervorragendes System, um eine proportionale Vertretung der Parteien, d. h. der von den Parteien ausgewählten Funktionäre und Kandidaten, egal ob Frauen oder Männer, in den politischen Organen zu erreichen.
lsp.judge: Ms. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather to a democracy deficit, and the candidate lists compiled by the parties - which, as you recommend in your report, are even compiled as lists with a quota regulation, where it is no longer even possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system for achieving proportional representation of the parties, i.e. the party-selected officials and candidates, regardless of whether they are women or men, in the political bodies.
lsp.proxy: Ms. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or even young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather to a democratic deficit. The election lists that parties submit - which, as you recommend in your report, could even be quota-regulated lists where it is no longer possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system to achieve proportional representation of parties, i.e., of the party-selected officials and candidates, whether they are women or men, in political bodies.
lsp.reference: Mrs. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or also of young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather a democracy deficit, and the electoral lists that are set up by the parties - even those that, as you recommend in your report, are set up as lists with a quota regulation, where it is no longer even possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system to achieve a proportional representation of the parties, i.e. the officials and candidates selected by the parties, regardless of whether they are women or men, in the political organs.

lsp.query: Die Wirklichkeit zeigt jedoch, dass dies ungeachtet der mannigfachen Empfehlungen und Entschließungen ein Bereich ist, in dem nach wie vor größere Ungleichgewichte herrschen und Frauen in den politischen Entscheidungsgremien - sowohl im wirtschaftlichen und sozialen als auch im politischen Leben - erheblich unterrepräsentiert sind. Dies wiederum trägt dazu bei, dass die vorhandenen Ungleichheiten und Diskriminierungen weiter bestehen.
lsp.judge: However, reality shows that despite the numerous recommendations and resolutions, this remains an area where significant imbalances persist and women are considerably underrepresented in political decision-making bodies - both in economic and social as well as political life. This, in turn, contributes to the continued existence of existing inequalities and discrimination.

lsp.query: Dies bedeutet auch, dass Männer und Frauen in Bereichen des öffentlichen und privaten Lebens die gleiche Verantwortung übernehmen, um neue Praktiken gegen die Diskriminierung zu fördern, und zwar auch in den politischen Parteien und öffentlichen und privaten Verwaltungen. Das Ziel muss lauten, psychologische und praktische Hindernisse für die Mitwirkung der Frauen in den Entscheidungsgremien und im politischen Leben auszuräumen und so Rückschritten wie der kürzlichen Abschaffung des Gleichstellungsministeriums durch die Regierung in Portugal zu begegnen.
lsp.judge: This also means that men and women in both the public and private spheres must take on equal responsibility for promoting new practices against discrimination, including in political parties and public and private administrations. The goal must be to remove psychological and practical barriers to women's participation in decision-making bodies and political life, and thus to counter setbacks such as the recent abolition of the Ministry for Equality by the government in Portugal.

lsp.query: Man sollte vielmehr die politischen Parteien auffordern, ihre Strukturen und Verfahren zu reformieren, um die unmittelbaren und mittelbaren Hindernisse für die Mitwirkung der Frauen aus dem Wege zu räumen, wobei selbstverständlich die Staaten selbst durch finanzielle Anreize die Parteien ermutigen könnten, möglichst viele Kandidatinnen auf die Wahllisten zu setzen.
lsp.judge: Instead, one should urge political parties to reform their structures and procedures in order to remove the immediate and indirect obstacles to women's participation, while states themselves could, of course, encourage parties through financial incentives to put as many female candidates on the ballot lists as possible.
lsp.proxy: One should rather urge political parties to reform their structures and procedures to remove the direct and indirect obstacles to women's participation, with states naturally encouraging parties through financial incentives to place as many female candidates as possible on the election lists.

lsp.query: Die doppelte Belastung durch familiäre Pflichten und Berufstätigkeit kann man meiner Meinung nach nicht als Diskriminierung bezeichnen, und sie ist auch kein zweifacher Nachteil wie in Erwägungsgrund D dargestellt. Familie und Beruf miteinander verbinden zu können, stellt eher ein hohes Maß an Organisationstalent und eine nicht zu unterschätzende Lebenserfahrung dar, die als besondere Qualifikation für Führungspersönlichkeiten gewertet werden muss.
lsp.judge: In my opinion, the double burden of family obligations and professional activity cannot be described as discrimination, nor is it a double disadvantage as presented in point D. Being able to combine family and work represents a high degree of organizational talent and a significant life experience that must be valued as a special qualification for leadership positions.
lsp.proxy: The double burden of family duties and professional activity, in my opinion, cannot be described as discrimination, and it is also not a double disadvantage as presented in consideration point D. The ability to combine family and career requires a high level of organizational talent and a significant life experience that must be valued as a special qualification for leadership positions.
lsp.reference: The double burden of family obligations and professional activity cannot, in my opinion, be described as discrimination, and it is also not a double disadvantage as presented in Ground D. Being able to connect family and profession is rather a high level of organizational talent and a not to be underestimated life experience that must be valued as a special qualification for leaders.

lsp.query: Da er sich aber wesentlich langsamer erneuert, müsste eine neue, eine dritte Kategorie geschaffen werden, die zwischen fossilen und schnell erneuerbaren Energiequellen liegt, das heißt die Kategorie die eines Brennstoffs mit langsamer Regeneration.
lsp.judge: Since it renews itself significantly slower, a new, third category would have to be created, which lies between fossil and quickly renewable energy sources, namely the category of a fuel with slow regeneration.
lsp.proxy: Since it renewes significantly more slowly, a new, third category would have to be created, which lies between fossil and rapidly renewable energy sources, i.e., the category of a fuel with slow regeneration.
lsp.reference: Since he renews himself significantly slower, a new category, a third category, would have to be created, which lies between fossil and quickly renewable energy sources, that is, the category of a fuel with slower regeneration.

lsp.query: So kann ich Ihnen also ganz freimütig meine Meinung sagen: wenn eine Vertagung der Abstimmung über einen Bericht beantragt wird, der für Donnerstag Abend vorgesehen ist und von einem Abgeordneten vorgestellt werden muss, der einen Heimweg von 2000 km vor sich hat und der, wenn er den einzigen verfügbaren Flug am Donnerstag Nachmittag nicht erreicht, nicht vor Freitag Abend zu Hause sein kann, so wird man wohl auch in Zukunft flexibel in der Einschätzung seiner Lage sein können.
lsp.judge: Therefore, I can freely express my opinion: if a postponement of the vote on a report scheduled for Thursday evening is requested, and this report is to be presented by a member of parliament who has a 2,000 km journey home and who, if he misses the only available flight on Thursday afternoon, cannot be home until Friday evening, then one can probably also be flexible in assessing the situation in the future.

lsp.query: Eine Reform der Schulung (beispielsweise Verkehrserziehung bereits in der Schule und Schulung in Notbremsung in der Fahrschule), die Systematisierung der aktiven und passiven Sicherheitselemente auch in einfachen Kraftfahrzeugen durch steuerliche Anreize für die Hersteller oder die Veränderung der Infrastrukturen, indem die "Unfallschwerpunkte " völlig beseitigt werden, das sind die echten Herausforderungen einer intelligenten Politik der Straßenverkehrssicherheit.
lsp.judge: A reform of training (for example, traffic education already in school and training in emergency braking in driving school), the systematization of active and passive safety elements also in simple vehicles through tax incentives for manufacturers or the modification of infrastructure by completely eliminating "accident hotspots", these are the real challenges of a smart road safety policy.
lsp.proxy: Reforming training (for example, traffic education already in school and training in emergency braking at driving schools), systematizing active and passive safety elements also in simple vehicles through tax incentives for manufacturers or changing infrastructure by completely eliminating "accident hotspots," these are the true challenges of an intelligent policy for road traffic safety.
lsp.reference: A reform of training (for example, traffic education already in school and training in emergency braking in driving school), the systematization of active and passive safety elements also in simple vehicles through fiscal incentives for manufacturers or the change of infrastructure by completely eliminating the "accident hotspots", these are the real challenges of an intelligent policy of road safety.

lsp.query: Diese Problematik ist für den Alpenbereich - und ich komme ja aus dem Alpenbereich - und vor allem in Bezug auf die Alpentransversale München-Verona von ganz besonderer Bedeutung, und wir hoffen, dass sich die Kommission durch das neuerliche Votum, das das Parlament hier zum Ausdruck gebracht hat, veranlasst sieht, die entsprechenden Vorbereitungsarbeiten noch zu beschleunigen und mit viel größerer Konzentration und Stärke voranzutreiben, als es bisher erfolgt ist, damit dieses dringende Problem im Alpenbereich einer Lösung zugeführt werden kann.
lsp.judge: This issue is of particular importance for the Alpine region - and I come from the Alpine region - and especially in relation to the Alpine Transversal Munich-Verona. We hope that the Commission, spurred on by the renewed vote expressed by Parliament here, will see fit to accelerate the relevant preparatory work and drive it forward with much greater concentration and strength than has been the case so far, so that this urgent problem in the Alpine region can be solved.

lsp.query: Lino Miserotti sagte zu mir: "Ich als Rentner finde es richtig, dass ich für die Benutzung dieser Autobahn eine Maut bezahlen muss, denn so leiste ich einen Beitrag zum Bau und zur Unterhaltung von Autobahnen, die eine wichtige Verkehrsinfrastruktur darstellen. Doch es wäre gut, wenn die Arbeitnehmer, die einer Arbeit nachgehen und sich noch nicht im Ruhestand befinden, von der Gebührenzahlung befreit würden. "
lsp.judge: Lino Miserotti said to me: "As a retiree, I think it's right that I have to pay a toll for using this highway, because that way I contribute to the construction and maintenance of highways, which are an important part of the transportation infrastructure. But it would be good if workers who are still working and not yet retired were exempt from paying the toll."
lsp.proxy: Lino Miserotti told me: "As a retiree, I find it right that I have to pay a toll for using this motorway, because in this way I contribute to the construction and maintenance of motorways, which represent an important transportation infrastructure. However, it would be good if employees who are still working and not yet retired were exempt from paying the toll."
lsp.reference: Lino Miserotti told me: "As a retiree, I think it's right that I have to pay a toll for using this highway because in this way I contribute to the construction and maintenance of highways, which represent an important traffic infrastructure. However, it would be good if working people, who are still employed and not yet in retirement, were exempt from paying the fee."

lsp.query: Wenn der Kraftstoffpreis schwindelerregend hoch ist und das Fünf- bis Sechsfache dessen beträgt, was das Benzin beim Verlassen der Raffinerie kostet, weil er sich zu mehr als 80 % aus Steuern zusammensetzt, so kann man wohl sagen, dass der Straßennutzer, gemessen an der Nutzung seines Fahrzeugs, bereits in hohem Maße dafür zur Kasse gebeten wird, dass er öffentliche Straßeninfrastrukturen nutzt.
lsp.judge: When the fuel price is exorbitantly high and is five to six times what gasoline costs leaving the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can safely say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already being heavily charged for using public road infrastructure.
lsp.proxy: When the fuel price is dizzyingly high, and amounts to five to six times what gasoline costs when it leaves the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can say that the road user is already contributing significantly to the cost of using public road infrastructure based on the use of their vehicle.
lsp.reference: If the fuel price is dizzyingly high and is five to six times that of gasoline when it leaves the refinery, because it is composed of more than 80% taxes, then one can say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already being asked for a high amount to use public street infrastructure.

lsp.query: Für uns sollte dies Anlass ein, unsere Stimme zu erheben, um diese Machenschaften Russlands gegenüber seinem ehemaligen Vasallen zu verurteilen, und durch konkretes Handeln zur politischen Stabilisierung dieser Region und ihrem ökonomischen Aufschwung beizutragen. Und dann sollten wir, wie in der Entschließung vorgeschlagen, einen Sondergesandten für den Südkaukasus benennen, denn ein Flächenbrand im Südkaukasus würde auch Europa nicht verschonen.
lsp.judge: For us, this should be an occasion to raise our voices to condemn these machinations of Russia against its former vassal, and to contribute through concrete action to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing. And then, as proposed in the resolution, we should appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, because a wildfire in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.

lsp.query: Ich appelliere an den Kommissar, unsere humanitäre Hilfe zur politischen Priorität Nr. 1 zu machen - für die USA und für Russland ist die Kaukasusregion längst Priorität -, weil ich das Gefühl habe, dass die Europäische Union - abgesehen von der Kollegin Schleicher, die eine großartige Arbeit leistet - dabei ist, diese Herausforderung zu verschlafen.
lsp.judge: I appeal to the commissioner to make our humanitarian aid a top political priority - for the USA and Russia, the Caucasus region has long been a priority - because I feel that the European Union - apart from colleague Schleicher, who is doing great work - is in danger of sleeping through this challenge.

ilsp.query: Frau Präsidentin! Wie schon mehrere Male zuvor und in meinen mehrfachen Schreiben an Sie zum Ausdruck gebracht, möchte ich auch mit meiner heutigen Wortmeldung darauf hinweisen, dass in der Türkei seit dem 20. Oktober, also seit Monaten, Hunderte unter menschenunwürdigen Bedingungen lebende politische Gefangene in einem Hungerstreik stehen, wobei sie auch den Tod in Kauf nehmen - einige von ihnen sind bereits gestorben -, damit die türkische Regierung ihr Vorhaben, sie in weiße Einzelzellen zu sperren und dadurch ihre Moral und ihren Widerstand zu brechen, nicht verwirklichen kann.
ilsp.judge: Madam President! As I have already expressed several times before and in my numerous letters to you, I would also like to point out with my statement today that for months, since October 20th, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions in Turkey have been on hunger strike, even accepting death - some of them have already died - so that the Turkish government cannot carry out its plan to lock them up in white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and their resistance.
ilsp.proxy: Madam President! As I have expressed on several occasions and in my multiple letters to you, I would like to draw your attention once again with today's statement that hundreds of political prisoners in Turkey have been on a hunger strike since October 20th, thus for months, living under inhuman conditions, and are even willing to risk death – some of them have already passed away – in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to confine them to white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and resistance.
ilsp.reference: Madam President! As I have already expressed on several occasions and in my multiple written submissions to you, I would like to draw your attention once again today to the fact that in Turkey, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on hunger strike since October 20, putting their lives at risk - some of them have already died - in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to imprison them in white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and their resistance.

ilsp.query: Der Übergang zur Wissensgesellschaft, die Globalisierung der Wirtschaft, der soziale, demokratische und ökologische Wandel sowie tiefgreifende Veränderungen in der Arbeitswelt, nicht zuletzt durch die neuen Technologien, das sind die großen Herausforderungen im dritten Jahrtausend, die auch neue Anstrengungen im Bildungsbereich erfordern.
