ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich gratuliere Frau de Veyrac zu ihrer engagierten Erarbeitung des Themas "Übereinkommen zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union ", denn mit ihrem Bericht wird unterstrichen, wie unerlässlich ein nachhaltiges Eintreten Europas für diese so wichtige Frage ist und welcher Maßnahmen es zudem weltweit bedarf.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, I congratulate Ms. de Veyrac on her dedicated work on the topic "Agreement for the Protection of World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union," because her report highlights how essential it is for Europe to take a sustainable stance on this important issue and what measures are also needed worldwide.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, I congratulate Mrs. de Veyrac on her engaged elaboration of the topic "Convention for the Protection of Cultural and Natural Heritage of Europe in the States of the European Union," for her report underscores how indispensable it is for Europe to take sustained action on this crucial issue and what global measures are also required.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, I congratulate Mrs. de Veyrac on her dedicated work on the topic "Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union", as her report underscores the importance of Europe's sustainable commitment to this crucial issue and the need for further measures worldwide.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte darauf verweisen, und das wird auch in dem Bericht anerkannt, dass in fünf Bereichen - Rechnungsabschluss, Institutionelle Probleme hinsichtlich Verwaltung und Kontrolle, Büros für Technische Hilfe, partnerschaftlich durchgeführte Verwaltung der Gemeinschaftspolitiken und Bekämpfung von Betrug und Korruption - zwar Fortschritte erzielt worden sind, gleichwohl aber noch eine Menge aufzuarbeiten bleibt.
ilsp.judge: I would like to point out, and this is also acknowledged in the report, that while progress has been made in five areas - closing accounts, institutional problems regarding administration and control, technical assistance offices, partnership-based administration of common policies, and combating fraud and corruption - there is still a lot of work to be done.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to point out, and this will also be acknowledged in the report, that progress has been made in five areas - final accounts, institutional problems concerning administration and control, offices for technical assistance, jointly managed community policies on a partnership basis, and combating fraud and corruption - yet there is still much to be done.
ilsp.reference: I would like to draw attention to the fact, and this is also acknowledged in the report, that while progress has been made in five areas - financial reporting, institutional issues regarding administration and control, technical assistance offices, partnership-based administration of community policies, and combating fraud and corruption - there is still a lot of work to be done.

ilsp.query: Der Rechnungshof erinnert uns daran, dass bei zwingend vorgeschriebenen Sicherheitsleistungen der Grundsatz gilt, dass sie von den Zollbehörden in einer Höhe festzusetzen sind, die dem genauen Betrag der Zollschuld entspricht, sofern dieser Betrag zweifelsfrei ermittelt werden kann, oder andernfalls dem von den Zollbehörden geschätzten höchstmöglichen Betrag der Zollschuld, die entstanden ist oder entstehen kann.
ilsp.judge: The Federal Audit Office reminds us that in the case of mandatory security requirements, the principle applies that they must be set by the customs authorities at an amount that corresponds to the exact amount of the customs duty, if this amount can be determined without a doubt, or otherwise at the highest possible amount of customs duty estimated by the customs authorities that has arisen or may arise.
ilsp.proxy: The Court of Auditors reminds us that in the case of mandatory security arrangements, the principle applies that these must be set by the customs authorities at an amount exactly corresponding to the customs debt, provided that this amount can be determined without doubt, or alternatively at the highest possible amount of the customs debt estimated by the customs authorities, which has arisen or may arise.
ilsp.reference: The Court of Auditors reminds us that in the case of mandatory security measures, the principle applies that they must be set by the customs authorities at a level corresponding to the exact amount of the customs debt, provided that this amount can be determined with certainty, or otherwise at the highest estimated amount of the customs debt that has arisen or may arise.

ilsp.query: Erwiesenermaßen war es richtig, das Büro in Thessaloniki zu belassen, denn hätten wir es nach Pristina ausgelagert, hätte Jugoslawien heute keinerlei Aussicht auf eine finanzielle Unterstützung durch die Agentur für Wiederaufbau, denn kein Serbe könnte jemals nach Pristina reisen, um dort auch nur einen Euro einzufordern.
ilsp.judge: It was proven right to keep the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had moved it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no chance of receiving financial support from the Reconstruction Agency, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even one euro.
ilsp.proxy: It turned out to be correct to keep the office in Thessaloniki, as if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have had no chance of receiving any financial support from the Reconstruction Agency today, since no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a single euro.
ilsp.reference: It was undoubtedly the right decision to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Reconstruction Agency, since no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a single euro.

ilsp.query: Die tiefgreifende politische Umgestaltung der Strukturen der bundesdeutschen Regierung ist ein deutliches Signal dafür, dass es selbst im Herzen Europas, wo die GAP entworfen wurde und wo sie stets ihre große Stütze fand, immer unhaltbarer ist, ein Modell einer Agrarpolitik aufrecht zu erhalten, das zur Bewahrung des industriellen Systems und der großen landwirtschaftlichen Betriebe konzipiert wurde.
ilsp.judge: The profound political reshaping of the structures of the German government is a clear signal that even in the heart of Europe, where the CAP was designed and where it has always found its strong support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises.
ilsp.proxy: The profound political restructuring of the federal German government's structures is a clear signal that it is increasingly untenable to maintain an agricultural policy model designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises, even at the heart of Europe where the Common Agricultural Policy was conceived and always found its strong support.
ilsp.reference: The far-reaching political restructuring of the federal government's structures is a clear indication that even at the heart of Europe, where the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) was designed and where it has always found its strong support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy that was conceived to preserve the industrial system and large-scale agricultural enterprises.

ilsp.query: Wir können nicht hinnehmen, dass Unternehmen, die in den Genuss von europäischen Beihilfen gekommen sind, wenn sie sich finanziell gesund gestoßen haben, aus Gründen der Strukturanpassung die Entlassung tausender Arbeitnehmer beschließen und damit deren Familien in eine Notlage bringen, zu deren Unterstützung dann wieder nationale und europäische öffentliche Gelder in Anspruch genommen werden.
ilsp.judge: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies, when they were already financially healthy, decide to lay off thousands of employees for structural adjustment reasons and thus bring their families into financial hardship, for which national and European public funds are then again required.
ilsp.proxy: We cannot accept that companies benefiting from European subsidies, when they have become financially sound due to structural adaptation, decide to lay off thousands of employees and thereby put their families in hardship, only to claim national and European public funds for support again.
ilsp.reference: We cannot accept that companies that have benefited from European subsidies, having financially recovered, decide to lay off thousands of employees for reasons of structural adjustment and thereby bring their families into a state of emergency, only to then again draw on national and European public funds for their support.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, sehr geehrte Damen und Herren Abgeordnete! Ich möchte zunächst den Herren Garriga, McCartin, Staes und Dell'Alba für die Berichte zu den insgesamt 10 Berichten des Rechnungshofs danken, die den Zeitraum 1999/2000 umfassen, bzw. dazu veröffentlicht worden sind.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, honourable ladies and gentlemen Members! I would like to thank Messrs. Garriga, McCartin, Staes and Dell'Alba for the reports on the ten reports of the Court of Auditors, which cover the period 1999/2000 and have been published accordingly.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, dear ladies and gentlemen Members of Parliament! I would like to thank Messrs Garriga, McCartin, Staes, and Dell'Alba first for the reports on the 10 Court of Auditors' reports that cover the period 1999/2000 or were published thereon.
ilsp.reference: Honorable President, esteemed Members of Parliament! I would like to thank Messrs. Garriga, McCartin, Staes and Dell'Alba for the reports on the total of 10 Court of Auditors' reports, which cover the period 1999/2000, and have been published accordingly.

ilsp.query: Die Europäische Zentralbank hat auf den Bericht geantwortet, aber ihre Antworten fielen sehr kurz aus, ich würde sagen kurz und knapp, und der Rechnungshof hielt diese für nicht ausreichend, da sie keinerlei Hinweise darauf enthielten, welche Schritte die EZB einzuleiten gedenkt, um die im Bericht des Rechnungshofs aufgedeckten Unzulänglichkeiten abzustellen.
ilsp.judge: The European Central Bank responded to the report, but their answers were very short, I would say short and to the point, and the Court of Auditors considered them insufficient because they did not contain any indication of what steps the ECB intends to take to remedy the shortcomings uncovered in the Court of Auditors' report.
ilsp.proxy: The European Central Bank responded to the report, but their answers were very brief, I would say short and to the point, and the Court of Auditors considered them insufficient as they contained no indications of the steps the ECB intends to take to address the deficiencies uncovered in the Court of Auditors' report.

ilsp.query: Wenn sich aber - und das sollte durchaus festgeschrieben werden - nach 18 Monaten bzw. nach zwei Jahren eine Bewertung als notwendig erweist und diese Bewertung ausweist, dass den Grenzarbeitnehmern unzumutbare Nachteile entstehen, dann muss die Möglichkeit bestehen, und diesen Punkt möchte ich in den Bericht aufgenommen sehen, eine andere Entscheidung zu treffen.
ilsp.judge: But if - and this should certainly be enshrined - after 18 months or two years an assessment proves necessary and this assessment shows that border workers are facing unacceptable disadvantages, then the possibility must exist, and I would like to see this point included in the report, to make a different decision.
ilsp.proxy: But if - and this should certainly be recorded - after 18 months or two years a review proves necessary and this review shows that the border workers are facing unacceptable disadvantages, then there must be the possibility to make a different decision, and this point I would like to see included in the report.
ilsp.reference: However, and this should be clearly stated - if an evaluation becomes necessary after 18 months or two years, and this evaluation shows that frontier workers are suffering unacceptable disadvantages, then there must be the possibility, and I would like to see this point included in the report, of making a different decision.

ilsp.query: (ES) Meine Zustimmung zum Bericht de Veyrac über die Umsetzung des Übereinkommens zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass es notwendig ist, die kulturelle Dimension der Europäischen Union weiterzuentwickeln und eine Kulturpolitik in der Union zu gewährleisten, die als eines der Hauptmerkmale ihres geistigen Reichtums und des Alten Kontinents die kulturelle, sprachliche, architektonische und künstlerische Vielfalt sowie alle jene Elemente zum Tragen bringt, die unser gemeinsames kulturelles Erbe darstellen.
ilsp.judge: My consent to the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the European Union member states is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main features of its intellectual wealth and of the Old Continent, brings to bear the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.proxy: My consent to the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of Cultural and Natural Heritage of World Heritage Sites in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a culture policy within the Union that, as one of the main features of its spiritual wealth and that of the Old Continent, secures cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.reference: My consent to the report by de Veyrac on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, encompasses the cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our shared cultural heritage.

ilsp.query: Bei diesen Faktoren handelt es sich erstens um die GAP, die vor allem nach 1992 und mit der Agenda 2000 eine Form angenommen hat, die den meisten landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben mittlerer Größe in der Gemeinschaft nicht das zum Überleben notwendige Einkommen garantiert, die den Haushaltsvorständen nicht den nötigen Lebensunterhalt sichert. Deshalb werden in einem Sektor wie der Landwirtschaft, die nicht nur keine Gewinne erwirtschaftet, sondern noch nicht einmal ein Mindesteinkommen gewährleistet, trotz der vielen Beihilfen - so viele sind es aber nun auch wieder nicht ­ nur wenige Investitionen, selbst in geringer Höhe, getätigt.
ilsp.judge: These factors first of all include the GAP, which, especially after 1992 and with Agenda 2000, has taken a form that does not guarantee the income necessary for survival to most medium-sized agricultural businesses in the Community, nor does it secure the necessary livelihood for household heads. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only generates no profits but does not even guarantee a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - although there aren't that many anymore - only few investments, even in small amounts, are made.
ilsp.proxy: These factors first refer to the GAP, which has taken on a form primarily after 1992 and with Agenda 2000, that does not guarantee sufficient income for survival to most medium-sized agricultural enterprises within the community, nor does it secure a decent living for budget authorities. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only fails to generate profits but also does not even ensure a minimum income, despite many subsidies – although there are indeed quite a few of them – only very few investments, even at low levels, are made.
ilsp.reference: It is primarily the CAP that is involved here, which, especially after 1992 and with the Agenda 2000, has taken on a form that does not guarantee the necessary income for the survival of most medium-sized agricultural businesses in the community, nor does it secure the necessary living expenses for the household heads. Therefore, in a sector like agriculture, which not only fails to generate profits but also does not even ensure a minimum income, despite the many subsidies - and there are not that many, after all - only a few investments, even of a small scale, have been made.

ilsp.query: Der Bericht unterstreicht die Notwendigkeit von Maßnahmen zur Förderung von Berufsanfängern und der unionsweiten Standardisierung. Wie der Berichterstatter feststellte, setzte sich auch der ausgezeichnete STOA-Bericht, der zu Beginn des vergangenen Jahres vorgelegt worden war, mit dieser Thematik auseinander.
ilsp.judge: The report underscores the need for measures to promote young professionals and union-wide standardization. As the rapporteur noted, the excellent STOA report, which was presented at the beginning of last year, also dealt with this issue.
ilsp.proxy: The report emphasizes the necessity of measures to promote young professionals and the uniform standardization across the union. As the rapporteur noted, the excellent STOA report presented at the beginning of the previous year also dealt with this theme.
ilsp.reference: The report highlights the need for measures to support new entrants to the workforce and for EU-wide standardization. As the rapporteur noted, the excellent STOA report, which was presented at the beginning of last year, also dealt with this issue.

ilsp.query: Diese Umweltschützer sind immer noch in Haft und da das Parlament bei der Wahrung der Interessen der Bewohner von Campo de Gibraltar und der Bucht von Algeciras - um es einmal so zu sagen - wenig Sensibilität gezeigt hat, bitte ich darum, dass man wenigstens geeignete Maßnahmen ergreift, damit diese pazifistischen Umweltschützer zu Hause schlafen können.
ilsp.judge: These environmental activists are still in custody, and since the Parliament has shown little sensitivity, so to speak, in upholding the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras, I request that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.
ilsp.proxy: These environmental activists are still in custody, and since the parliament has shown little sensitivity towards the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras, I beg that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.
ilsp.reference: These environmental activists are still in custody and since the parliament has shown little sensitivity in safeguarding the interests of the residents of Campo de Gibraltar and the Bay of Algeciras - to put it that way - I kindly request that at least appropriate measures be taken so that these pacifist environmental activists can sleep at home.

ilsp.query: Es muss sowohl den Bürgern der Europäischen Union als auch den Bürgern Marokkos klar sein, dass alle Institutionen der Europäischen Union, und zwar auf höchster Ebene, dieses Abkommen wollen: Der Europäische Rat will es und hat es so in Nizza erklärt, der Präsident der Kommission, der nach Rabat gereist ist, will es, und auch das Europäische Parlament in Straßburg will es.
ilsp.judge: It must be clear to both citizens of the European Union and citizens of Morocco that all institutions of the European Union, at the highest level, want this agreement: The European Council wants it and declared it so in Nice, the President of the Commission, who traveled to Rabat, wants it, and the European Parliament in Strasbourg also wants it.
ilsp.proxy: Both the citizens of the European Union and the citizens of Morocco must be clear that all institutions of the European Union, at the highest level, want this agreement: The European Council wants it and stated so in Nice, the President of the Commission, who traveled to Rabat, wants it, and also the European Parliament in Strasbourg wants it.
ilsp.reference: It must be clear to both citizens of the European Union and citizens of Morocco that all institutions of the European Union, at the highest level, want this agreement: The European Council wants it and has stated so in Nice, the President of the Commission, who has traveled to Rabat, wants it, and so does the European Parliament in Strasbourg.

ilsp.query: Ich bekräftige erneut meine Forderung, wie ich es in der Vergangenheit so häufig getan habe, dass zur Gewährleistung einer angemessenen Dezentralisierungspolitik der Zugang zu den Küstengewässern innerhalb der 12-Meilen-Zone weiterhin ausschließlich den Anrainerstaaten vorbehalten bleiben muss und dass diese ausschließliche Fischereizone auf 24 Seemeilen ausgedehnt wird, wie es dieses Haus im Februar 1999 gefordert hat.
ilsp.judge: I reiterate my demand, as I have done so often in the past, that access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone should continue to be reserved exclusively for riparian states to ensure an appropriate decentralization policy, and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.
ilsp.proxy: I reiterate my demand, as I have done in the past, that access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively reserved for the coastal states to ensure an appropriate decentralization policy, and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.
ilsp.reference: I reiterate my demand, as I have done so frequently in the past, that to ensure an appropriate policy of decentralization, access to coastal waters within the 12-mile zone must remain exclusively reserved for coastal states and that this exclusive fishing zone be extended to 24 nautical miles, as this House demanded in February 1999.

ilsp.query: Wir konnten auch die Schwachstellen im politischen Bereich kennen lernen, die ihren Ausdruck in einem äußerst gewalttätigen Klima finden, das die Beziehungen zwischen der Regierung von Frau Hasina Wajed, der Awani-Liga und den Oppositionskräften, insbesondere der Bangladesh National Party (BNP), die im Übrigen nicht regelmäßig an den Arbeiten des Parlaments teilnimmt, kennzeichnet.
ilsp.judge: We were also able to learn about the weaknesses in the political sphere, which find expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relations between the government of Mrs. Hasina Wajed, the Awami League and the opposition forces, in particular the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, by the way, does not regularly participate in the work of parliament.
ilsp.proxy: We also became acquainted with the weaknesses in the political sphere, which find expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relationships between the government under Mrs. Hasina Wajed, the Awami League, and opposition forces, particularly the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, incidentally, does not regularly participate in the parliamentary works.
ilsp.reference: We were also able to learn about the weaknesses in the political sphere, which found their expression in an extremely violent climate that characterizes the relationships between the government of Prime Minister Hasina Wajed, the Awami League, and the opposition forces, particularly the Bangladesh National Party (BNP), which, incidentally, does not regularly participate in the work of the parliament.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte Ihnen kurz die von der Allianz auf ihrer Tagung am 10. Januar getroffenen Maßnahmen in Erinnerung rufen: Erstens berief sie eine Beratung nationaler Militärmedizinexperten ein, um Kontakt miteinander aufzunehmen und alle Ideen, Sachverhalte, Ziele usw. auszutauschen; es wurde sofort eine Arbeitsgruppe gebildet, die als Zentrum für den Informationsaustausch dienen sollte und an der alle teilnehmen konnten - es scheint mir wichtig, das zu unterstreichen -, nicht nur die Länder der Allianz, sondern alle Länder, die in der einen oder anderen Weise an den friedenserhaltenden Operationen beteiligt waren.
ilsp.judge: I would like to briefly remind you of the measures taken by the Allianz at its meeting on January 10th: First, it convened a consultation of national military medical experts to establish contact and exchange all ideas, facts, goals, etc.; an immediate working group was formed, which was to serve as a center for information exchange and which all could participate in - it seems important to me to emphasize this - not only the countries of the Allianz, but all countries that were involved in peacekeeping operations in one way or another.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to briefly remind you of the measures taken by the Alliance at their meeting on January 10th: Firstly, they convened a consultation with national military medical experts to establish contact with each other and exchange all ideas, facts, objectives, etc.; an immediate working group was formed that should serve as a center for information exchange and to which all countries could participate - it seems important to emphasize this - not just the Alliance countries, but all countries that were in any way involved in peacekeeping operations.
ilsp.reference: I would like to remind you of the measures taken by the Alliance at their meeting on January 10th: Firstly, they convened a consultation of national military medical experts to establish contact with one another and exchange all ideas, matters, goals, etc.; an immediate working group was formed, which was intended to serve as a centre for information exchange and in which all could participate - I think it's essential to stress this - not only the Alliance member states, but all countries that were involved in some way in the peacekeeping operations.

ilsp.query: Was den Wunsch nach Verzicht auf eine geographische Begrenzung für diese schnelle Eingreiftruppe anbelangt, so erinnert dies an die Raubzüge der früheren Kolonialmächte in Afrika und anderswo, wie sie etwa von Frankreich begangen wurden, um vom Volk abgelehnte Diktatoren zu schützen, oder wie sie derzeit von Großbritannien in Sierra Leone durchgeführt werden.
ilsp.judge: As for the desire to waive a geographical limitation for this rapid reaction force, this recalls the raids of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those carried out by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as they are currently being carried out by Britain in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.proxy: Regarding the desire to forgo a geographical limitation for this rapid reaction force, this reminds us of the plundering expeditions of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those carried out by France to protect despotic leaders rejected by the people, or as they are currently conducted by the United Kingdom in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.reference: As for the desire to forgo geographical limitations for this rapid intervention force, this recalls the raids of the former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or those currently being carried out by the United Kingdom in Sierra Leone.

ilsp.query: Was seit der reichlich hysterischen Aufbauschung dieser Krise in den meisten unserer Mitgliedstaaten geschieht, trägt sicher nicht dazu bei, junge Menschen zu motivieren, in der Landwirtschaft zu bleiben und erst recht nicht, im ländlichen Raum ihre Zukunft zu sehen, wo sie, wie es in unserem Bericht so schön steht, eine wichtige soziale Funktion zu erfüllen haben, indem sie sich der Landschaftspflege und -erhaltung widmen und zur Deckung des wirtschaftlichen, sozialen und ökologischen Bedarfs des ländlichen Raums beitragen.
ilsp.judge: What is happening in most of our member states since the rather hysterical build-up of this crisis certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less so to see their future in the countryside, where, as our report so beautifully puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by dedicating themselves to landscape care and conservation and contributing to the economic, social and ecological needs of the countryside.
ilsp.proxy: What has happened since the rather hysterical hype of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture, let alone see their future in rural areas, where, as our report beautifully states, they have an important social function to fulfill by dedicating themselves to landscape conservation and contributing to the economic, social, and ecological needs of the countryside.
ilsp.reference: What has been happening since the over-the-top dramatization of this crisis in most of our member states certainly does not contribute to motivating young people to stay in agriculture and even less to seeing their future in rural areas, where, as our report so aptly puts it, they have an important social function to fulfill by devoting themselves to landscape care and conservation and contributing to meeting the economic, social, and ecological needs of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich habe zwar für diesen Bericht über die Gemeinsame Fischereipolitik gestimmt, doch fordere ich das Europäische Parlament, den Rat und die Kommission auf, einen unter Ziffer 20 des Berichts gehörenden, jedoch vergessenen Aspekt stärker im Auge zu haben und zu überwachen, nämlich auf welche Art und Weise bzw. ob überhaupt Rentenbetrag, -höhe und -bedingungen im Fischereisektor, und insbesondere der Rentner im Bereich der handwerklichen Fischerei, kontrolliert werden.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, although I voted in favour of this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, I call on the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission to pay closer attention to and monitor an aspect belonging to point 20 of the report, which has been overlooked, namely the way in which, or whether at all, pension amount, level and conditions in the fishing sector, and in particular for pensioners in the artisanal fishing sector, are controlled.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, although I voted for this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, I urge the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay more attention to and monitor an aspect that is mentioned under point 20 of the report but has been overlooked, namely how, or even if at all, pension amounts, levels, and conditions in the fisheries sector, and particularly among pensioners in the artisanal fishing sector, are controlled.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, I have indeed voted in favor of this report on the Common Fisheries Policy, but I call on the European Parliament, the Council, and the Commission to pay closer attention to and monitor a particular aspect mentioned under point 20 of the report, which has been overlooked, namely how, or indeed whether, pension amounts, levels, and conditions are controlled in the fishing sector, and particularly for pensioners in the artisanal fishing industry.

ilsp.query: Der Einsatz dieses Waffentyps durch die Vereinigten Staaten und andere NATO-Länder während des Golfkriegs, in Bosnien und im Kosovo hat bereits den Tod vieler Soldaten, Leiden und Todesfälle bei den Bewohnern der bombardierten Gebiete und die Verseuchung der Umwelt in den betroffenen Regionen verursacht.
ilsp.judge: The use of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia and Kosovo has already caused the death of many soldiers, suffering and fatalities among the inhabitants of the bombed areas and the contamination of the environment in the affected regions.
ilsp.proxy: The deployment of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia, and in Kosovo has already caused the deaths of many soldiers, suffering and fatalities among the inhabitants of the bombed areas, and environmental pollution in the affected regions.
ilsp.reference: The deployment of this type of weapon by the United States and other NATO countries during the Gulf War, in Bosnia, and in Kosovo has already caused the deaths of many soldiers, suffering, and fatalities among the inhabitants of the bombed areas, as well as environmental pollution in the affected regions.

ilsp.query: Der von mir bereits erwähnte Beschluss besagt, dass ein Bürger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates, der sich um konsularische Hilfe an eine diplomatische oder konsularische Vertretung eines anderen Mitgliedstaates wendet, so zu behandeln ist, als wäre er Bürger des Landes, das durch die betreffende Botschaft oder das Konsulat vertreten wird.
ilsp.judge: The resolution I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state shall be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate in question.
ilsp.proxy: The resolution I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state should be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate.
ilsp.reference: The decision I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state is to be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.

ilsp.query: Der Rat begrüßt außerdem die Tatsache, dass sich die EU und die ASEAN in ihrer in Vientiane beschlossenen gemeinsamen Erklärung verpflichten, die Bemühungen des Sonderbeauftragten des UNO-Generalsekretärs für Birma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, um eine positive Entwicklung in Burma zu unterstützen.
ilsp.judge: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN, in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane, commit to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Burma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Burma.
ilsp.proxy: The Council also welcomes that the EU and the ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane to support the efforts of the Special Adviser of the UN Secretary-General for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.
ilsp.reference: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN have committed themselves in their joint statement adopted in Vientiane to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Myanmar, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Myanmar.

ilsp.query: Im Ausschuss für Regionalpolitik, Verkehr und Fremdenverkehr ist man sich jedoch darüber im Klaren, dass die Gewerkschaften und die Luftfahrtunternehmen am besten geeignet sind, um eine Lösung für dieses Problem zu finden, und so haben sich die Mitglieder des Ausschusses in einem Kompromiss darauf geeinigt, allen Beteiligten bis zum 1. Mai 2001 Zeit zu geben, um eine Einigung zu erreichen, auf deren Grundlage dann der Text des neuen Abschnitts Q erstellt werden soll.
ilsp.judge: However, the Committee for Regional Policy, Transport and Tourism is aware that the trade unions and the airlines are best suited to find a solution to this problem, and so the committee members have agreed in a compromise to give all parties until May 1, 2001 to reach an agreement, on the basis of which the text of the new section Q will then be created.
ilsp.proxy: In the Committee on Regional Policy, Transport, and Tourism, it is clear that the trade unions and aviation companies are best suited to find a solution to this problem, and thus the committee members have agreed on a compromise to give all parties until May 1, 2001, to reach an agreement on which basis the text of the new section Q will then be drafted.
ilsp.reference: In the Committee on Regional Policy, Transport and Tourism, however, it is clear that the trade unions and the airlines are best suited to find a solution to this problem, and so the committee members have agreed on a compromise to give all parties until May 1, 2001, to reach an agreement, on the basis of which the text of the new section Q will then be created.

ilsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, this clearly shows that road safety cannot be sufficiently increased by isolated measures, but only by a comprehensive package of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, improved road construction, traffic management systems, higher safety standards for vehicles, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles on the road.
ilsp.proxy: In my opinion, it becomes clear here that traffic safety cannot be increased sufficiently through makeshift individual measures alone, but can only be achieved through a comprehensive range of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, better road infrastructure, traffic control systems, higher vehicle safety standards, stronger enforcement of traffic regulations, and also continuous inspection of vehicles in circulation.
ilsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Straßenverkehrssicherheit kann und muss sowohl für Europa insgesamt als auch für jedes einzelne Land eine Priorität darstellen. Deshalb stimme ich auch dem Vorschlag von Frau Hedkvist Petersen - die ich mir an dieser Stelle zu ihrem Bericht zu beglückwünschen erlaube - zu, einen strategischen Plan für die Straßenverkehrssicherheit zu entwerfen und eine Reihe strikter, aber auch realistischer quantitativer Ziele festzulegen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, road safety must be a priority for both Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also agree with Ms. Hedkvist Petersen's proposal - which I would like to congratulate her on at this point for her report - to develop a strategic plan for road safety and set a number of strict but also realistic quantitative goals.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, road traffic safety must and can be a priority for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That is why I also support Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen's proposal – which I would like to congratulate her on at this point regarding her report – to develop a strategic plan for road traffic safety and to set a series of strict but also realistic quantitative goals.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, road safety can and must be a priority both for Europe as a whole and for each individual country. That's why I also agree with the proposal by Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen - whom I would like to congratulate on her report at this point - to draw up a strategic plan for road safety and set a series of strict, but also realistic, quantitative targets.

ilsp.query: Der nächste Schritt muss darin bestehen, dass man in Erwägung zieht, in den Fällen, wo die Anlastung einiger dieser Kosten keinen Sinn mehr hätte - ich denke dabei an die italienischen Autobahnen, die sich weitgehend amortisiert haben -, mit diesen heute existierenden Gebühren Fonds zu bilden, die möglicherweise für Quersubventionen genutzt werden könnten, um zu erreichen, dass bestimmte den Straßenbenutzern auferlegte Gebühren für die Verbesserung der Infrastruktur anderer, mit Sicherheit umweltverträglicherer Verkehrsträger verwendet werden.
ilsp.judge: The next step must be to consider, in cases where relieving some of these costs would no longer make sense - I'm thinking of Italian motorways, which have largely been amortized - forming existing toll funds that could possibly be used for cross-subsidies to ensure that certain fees imposed on road users for the improvement of infrastructure of other, certainly more environmentally friendly modes of transport are used.
ilsp.proxy: The next step must be to consider forming funds with these existing tolls in cases where the imposition of some of these costs no longer makes sense – I am thinking of Italian motorways that have been largely paid off – which could then be used for cross-subsidies to ensure that certain tolls imposed on road users for the improvement of infrastructure of other, undoubtedly more environmentally friendly transport modes, are utilized.
ilsp.reference: The next step must be to consider forming funds using the existing fees in cases where the allocation of some of these costs would no longer make sense - I am thinking of the Italian motorways, which have largely been amortized - that could possibly be used for cross-subsidies to achieve the goal that certain fees imposed on road users are used for the improvement of the infrastructure of other, certainly more environmentally friendly modes of transport.

ilsp.query: Der Berichterstatter freut sich über die grundsätzliche Übereinstimmung in den im Bericht enthaltenen grundlegenden Prinzipien, nämlich darin, dass es in die Zuständigkeit der Gemeinschaft fällt, eine gemeinsame Methodik zur Berechnung der Kosten des Verkehrs zu entwickeln; dass externe Kosten in eine solche Bewertung einfließen sollten; dass die Einnahmen für die Verringerung von Umweltschäden und die Förderung des Übergangs zu umweltschonenderen Verkehrsträgern zu verwenden seien; dass die Umsetzung vom Prinzip der Subsidiarität bestimmt sein sollte; dass die Nutzer und Verursacher in Abhängigkeit von der Benutzung zahlen und dass Ausnahmen für die weniger mobilen Mitglieder der Gesellschaft und die Bewohner ländlicher Gebiete gelten sollten.
ilsp.judge: The reporter is pleased about the fundamental agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it is within the competence of the community to develop a common methodology for calculating transport costs; that external costs should be included in such an assessment; that the revenue should be used to reduce environmental damage and promote the transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport; that the implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay according to their use; and that exceptions should apply to less mobile members of society and residents of rural areas.
ilsp.proxy: The rapporteur is pleased with the fundamental agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it falls within the competence of the Community to develop a common methodology for calculating the costs of transport; that external costs should be taken into account in such an assessment; that revenues for reducing environmental damage and promoting the transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport should be used; that implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay according to their use; and that exemptions should apply for less mobile members of society and rural residents.
ilsp.reference: The rapporteur welcomes the fundamental agreement on the basic principles contained in the report, namely that it falls within the competence of the community to develop a common methodology for calculating the costs of transport; that external costs should be taken into account in such an assessment; that revenues for reducing environmental damage and promoting a transition to more environmentally friendly modes of transport should be used; that implementation should be determined by the principle of subsidiarity; that users and polluters should pay in proportion to their use; and that exceptions should apply to the less mobile members of society and residents of rural areas.

ilsp.query: Herr Kollege Posselt, selbst wenn es wirklich eine Bereicherung wäre, wenn Sie 20 Minuten redeten - ich könnte ja dann auch 20 Minuten reden, weil auch von unserer Fraktion keiner mehr da ist -, wäre es in der Tat so, dass die Arbeit, die der Kollege Deprez sehr sorgfältig durchgeführt hat, hier nicht in dem Maße diskutiert werden könnte, wie es angemessen wäre.
ilsp.judge: Mr. Colleague Posselt, even if it would really be a benefit if you spoke for 20 minutes - I could also speak for 20 minutes because no one from our faction is left either - it would be the case that the work that colleague Deprez has carried out very carefully could not be discussed here to the extent that would be appropriate.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, those of us who are older still remember the extraordinary, horrifying reports that came out of Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city because the Khmer Rouge, whose leader was trained in the doctrines of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, had relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in Year Zero.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, those of us who are older have not yet forgotten the extraordinary and horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city, as the Khmer Rouge, whose leaders were trained in the tradition of violence according to the principles of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathy, relocated two million people from the city to the countryside, under the leadership of "Great" Pol Pot, to begin a new society in the year zero.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, those of us who are older have not forgotten the extraordinary, horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city, because the Red Khmer, whose leaders were trained in the teachings of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and were filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, forcibly relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in Year Zero.

lsp.query: Frau Präsidentin, ich möchte Sie und meine Kolleginnen und Kollegen darauf aufmerksam machen, dass ich zwar die Gründe kenne, die Sie dazu veranlasst haben, den Kahn und damit die Tagesordnung vom Mittwoch derart zu überladen, was die zu erörternden politischen Themen betrifft, jedoch verfügen Rat und Kommission über die gleiche Redezeit wie alle Europaabgeordneten zusammen: 90 Minuten für den Rat und die Kommission, 90 Minuten für die Abgeordneten.
lsp.judge: Madam President, I would like to draw your attention, and that of my colleagues, to the fact that while I understand the reasons that led you to overload the agenda for Wednesday, both in terms of the number of items and the political issues to be discussed, the Council and the Commission have the same speaking time as all the Members of the European Parliament combined: 90 minutes for the Council and the Commission, 90 minutes for the Members.
lsp.proxy: Madam President, I would like to draw your attention and that of my fellow Members to the fact that, although I am aware of the reasons that led you to overload the agenda for Wednesday in this way, as regards the political issues to be discussed, the Council and the Commission have the same speaking time as all the Members of the European Parliament put together: 90 minutes for the Council and the Commission, 90 minutes for the Members.

lsp.query: Meiner Ansicht nach können wir nicht auf der einen Seite die Vollbeschäftigung zu einer Aktionspriorität der Europäischen Union erheben und uns mit der Ausarbeitung eines Statuts der Europäischen Aktiengesellschaft beschäftigen, das neue Rechte für Arbeitnehmer vorsieht, und auf der anderen Seite passiv eine derartige Strategie hinnehmen, die den Gesetzen der Aktienmärkte Vorrang vor allen anderen Erwägungen einräumt.
lsp.judge: In my view, we cannot, on the one hand, elevate full employment to a priority action of the European Union and engage in the development of a statute for a European public limited company that provides new rights for employees, and, on the other hand, passively accept a strategy that prioritizes the laws of the stock markets above all other considerations.
lsp.proxy: In my view, we cannot on the one hand make full employment a priority action of the European Union and work on a statute for the European company which provides new rights for employees, and on the other hand passively accept a strategy which gives precedence to the laws of the stock market over all other considerations.
lsp.reference: In my opinion, we cannot elevate full employment to a priority of the European Union on one side and engage in drafting a statute for the European Company that provides new rights for employees, while passively accepting a strategy on the other side that gives precedence to the laws of the stock markets over all other considerations.

lsp.query: Frau Präsidentin! Meine Fraktion wird diesem Vorschlag zustimmen, weil wir genau die Ansichten von Herrn Wurtz teilen, dass es sich hierbei wegen der Bedeutung der Danone-Firmengruppe und der Auswirkungen der vorgeschlagenen Maßnahmen auf mehrere Länder nicht um eine rein französische, sondern um eine europäische Angelegenheit handelt.
lsp.judge: Madam President! My group will support this proposal because we share the views of Mr Wurtz that, given the importance of the Danone group of companies and the impact the proposed measures will have on several countries, this is not a purely French, but a European matter.
lsp.proxy: Madam President! My group will agree to this proposal because we share exactly the views of Mr Wurtz that, given the importance of the Danone group and the impact of the proposed measures on several countries, this is not a purely French but a European matter.
lsp.reference: Madam President! My faction will support this proposal because we exactly share the views of Mr. Wurtz that, due to the importance of the Danone Group and the effects of the proposed measures on several countries, this is not a purely French, but a European matter.

lsp.query: Ich möchte die Präsidentin bitten, der Regierung in Ankara gegenüber unsere Sorge über diesen Vorfall sowie unsere Hoffnung, dass dieser bedauerliche Vorfall die Lösung des Zypernproblems und die wieder aufgenommenen Friedensverhandlungen nicht beeinträchtigen möge, wie wir auch hoffen, dass Herr Tsiakourmas so schnell wie möglich wieder auf freien Fuß gesetzt wird.
lsp.judge: I would like to ask the President to convey to the government in Ankara our concern about this incident and our hope that this regrettable incident will not affect the solution of the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace talks, as we also hope that Mr. Tsiakourmas will be released as soon as possible.
lsp.proxy: I would like to ask the President to express to the government in Ankara our concern about this incident, as well as our hope that this unfortunate incident will not affect the solution to the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace talks, just as we also hope that Mr. Tsiakourmas will be released as soon as possible.
lsp.reference: I would like to ask the President to request the government in Ankara to take note of our concern over this incident and our hope that this unfortunate incident may not hinder the solution of the Cyprus problem and the resumed peace negotiations, as we also hope that Mr. Tsiakourmas will be released as soon as possible.

lsp.query: Zudem lehnt es Herr Denktasch, der Führer "Nord-Zyperns ", das - nur zur Erinnerung - unter türkischer Besatzung steht, ab, an weiteren Gesprächen zur Lösung des Zypernproblems teilzunehmen. Offensichtlich fühlt er sich weitaus stärker als je zuvor, nachdem die Europäische Union die Türkei ohne langes Nachdenken, wie ich meine, in den Kreis der EU-Beitrittskandidaten aufgenommen hat.
lsp.judge: Furthermore, Mr. Denktasch, the leader of "Northern Cyprus," which, as a reminder, is under Turkish occupation, refuses to participate in further talks to resolve the Cyprus problem. Obviously, he feels far stronger than ever before, especially since the European Union, in my opinion, without much deliberation, admitted Turkey to the circle of EU candidate countries.

lsp.query: Faktisch soll diese Richtlinie Sicherheit hinsichtlich der Vorschriften bieten, die kohärente und sektorspezifische Regelungen für die Institute, die Aktiva, die Rechte und die geschäftlichen Beziehungen vorsehen, falls eine in mehreren Mitgliedstaaten der Union tätige Bank in Schwierigkeiten gerät oder Konkurs anmelden muss.

lsp.query: In seinem mit qualifizierter Mehrheit angenommenen Gemeinsamen Standpunkt beweist der Rat ein feines und sicheres Gespür für die Eigenheiten des Banksektors, die ihn sowohl hinsichtlich des Insolvenzverfahrens generell als auch eines Vergleichs mit den anderen Finanzsektoren, wie dem Versicherungswesen und dem Wertpapierhandel, eine Sonderstellung einnehmen lassen.
lsp.judge: In its common position, adopted by a qualified majority, the Council demonstrates a fine and sure sense of the specific features of the banking sector, which sets it apart from other financial sectors, such as insurance and securities trading, both in terms of insolvency proceedings in general and in comparison with them.
lsp.proxy: In its common position adopted by qualified majority, the Council demonstrates a fine and secure sense of the specific characteristics of the banking sector, which give it a special position both in terms of insolvency proceedings in general and in comparison with other financial sectors, such as insurance and securities trading.
lsp.reference: In its Common Position adopted by a qualified majority, the Council demonstrates a fine and secure sense of the idiosyncrasies of the banking sector, which, in general terms, as well as in comparison with other financial sectors, such as insurance and securities trading, entitles it to a special position in the context of insolvency proceedings.

lsp.query: In dem Bericht von Frau Peijs - zu dem ich ihr im Namen der Kommission gratulieren möchte, wobei ich mich den Komplimenten von Frau Villiers und Herrn Skinner gern anschließe -, der weitestgehend positiv zu dem Gemeinsamen Standpunkt steht, werden - wie heute Abend bereits erwähnt - mehrere Änderungsanträge zu Artikel 20 vorgeschlagen.
lsp.judge: In the report by Ms Peijs - to whom I would like to offer my congratulations on behalf of the Commission, associating myself with the compliments made by Ms Villiers and Mr Skinner - which largely supports the Common Position, several amendments to Article 20 are proposed, as has already been mentioned this evening.

lsp.reference: In the report by Mrs. Peijs - to which I would like to extend my congratulations on behalf of the Commission, where I gladly join in the compliments from Mrs. Villiers and Mr. Skinner -, which largely stands in a positive view to the Common Position, several amendments to Article 20 are proposed - as already mentioned this evening -.

lsp.query: Anstatt jedoch die Kommission noch heftiger zu kritisieren als es der Berichterstatter bereits getan hat, anstatt einfach auf die vier Ausschüsse zu verweisen, die in dieser Frage beteiligt sind, möchte ich einen Punkt hervorheben, den auch der Berichterstatter erwähnte, dass es nämlich vor allem unsere Aufgabe ist ­ die Aufgabe der Abgeordneten dieses Hohen Hauses ­ dafür zu sorgen, dass die Rechtsvorschriften von Anfang an besser sind.
lsp.judge: Instead of, however, criticizing the Commission even more harshly than the rapporteur has already done, instead of simply referring to the four committees involved in this matter, I would like to highlight a point that the rapporteur also mentioned, namely that it is primarily our task—the task of the Members of this Honourable House—to ensure that legislation is better from the outset.

lsp.query: Wir begrüßen deshalb die in Lissabon vorgelegten Vorschläge für bessere Regelungen, bei denen die Kosten der Rechtsvorschriften berücksichtigt werden; wir begrüßen das informelle Treffen der Minister für öffentliche Verwaltung am 7. November in Straßburg; wir begrüßen die Schaffung einer hochrangigen Gruppe zur Prüfung der Empfehlungen zur kostengünstigeren Gestaltung der Rechtsvorschriften; wir sind jedoch enttäuscht, dass der zugesagte Vertreter des Europäischen Parlaments in diesem Gremium weder vom Parlament ernannt worden ist noch man, soweit mir bekannt ist, an uns herangetreten ist, einen solchen Vertreter zu ernennen.
lsp.judge: We therefore welcome the proposals for better regulations, which take into account the costs of legislation, presented in Lisbon; we welcome the informal meeting of Ministers for Public Administration on 7 November in Strasbourg; we welcome the establishment of a high-level group to examine the recommendations for making legislation more cost-effective; however, we are disappointed that the promised representative of the European Parliament in this group has neither been appointed by the Parliament nor, as far as I know, has anyone approached us to appoint such a representative.
lsp.proxy: We therefore welcome the proposals presented in Lisbon for better regulation, taking into account the costs of legislation; we welcome the informal meeting of Ministers for Public Administration on 7 November in Strasbourg; we welcome the creation of a high-level group to examine the recommendations for making legislation more cost-effective; however, we are disappointed that the European Parliament's representative, as promised, has neither been appointed by the Parliament nor, to my knowledge, has approached us to appoint such a representative.
lsp.reference: We therefore welcome the proposals put forward in Lisbon for better regulations that take into account the costs of the legal provisions; we welcome the informal meeting of the ministers for public administration on 7 November in Strasbourg; we welcome the creation of a high-level group to examine the recommendations for a more cost-effective design of the legal provisions; however, we are disappointed that the promised representative of the European Parliament has neither been appointed by the Parliament nor, as far as I am aware, approached us to appoint such a representative.

lsp.query: Es kann unsere Arbeit im Europäischen Parlament nur entwerten, wenn zum Beispiel darauf verwiesen werden kann, dass die Altauto-Richtlinie Hersteller und Verbraucher jährlich 400 Mio. £ kostet, wohingegen der Nutzen für die Umwelt lediglich 100 Mio. £ im Jahr beträgt.
lsp.judge: It can only devalue our work in the European Parliament if, for example, it can be pointed out that the End-of-Life Vehicles Directive costs manufacturers and consumers £400 million per year, whereas the benefit for the environment is only £100 million per year.

lsp.query: Ich habe dies getan, um dem Subsidiaritätsprinzip zu seinem Recht zu verhelfen, und ich tue es auch unter Hinweis auf die Worte von Romano Prodi letztes Jahr in diesem Parlament, als er sagte: "Let us remember how often we have been made into a laughing stock because we deal with things that are absolutely ridiculous, which defy common sense and conflict with the interests of our population ".

lsp.query: Ich möchte vor allem zwei Punkte hervorheben: Mir ist unverständlich, dass die Kommission immer noch nichts unternommen hat, um eine Kammer für Haushaltsdisziplin beim Rechnungshof oder beim Gerichtshof einzurichten und so eine wirksame Anwendung der Bestimmungen der Haushaltsordnung betreffend die finanzielle Haftbarkeit der Beamten für von ihnen verursachte Schäden zu gewährleisten.
lsp.judge: Above all, I would like to highlight two points: It is incomprehensible to me that the Commission has still not taken any action to establish a chamber for budgetary discipline at the Court of Auditors or the Court of Justice and thus ensure the effective application of the provisions of the financial regulations concerning the financial liability of officials for damage caused by them.

lsp.judge: We have a surplus in the entire milk production sector, which results in many other problems, particularly in the area of financial control, because specific sales promotion measures for skim milk powder and butterfat result from this surplus, which repeatedly cause major problems in financial control or - in other words - give rise to fraud.

lsp.query: Die Definition des beihilfefähigen Magermilchpulvers wurde präzisiert, die Kontrollverfahren wurden insbesondere in Bezug auf den Nachweis von Molke im Magermilchpulver überprüft, und die Beihilfen für flüssige Magermilch zu Futterzwecken wurden aus Kosten-Nutzen-Erwägungen abgeschafft, etwas, wozu es auch eine Menge Kritik gab.
lsp.judge: The definition of eligible skim milk powder was refined, the control procedures were reviewed, particularly regarding the detection of whey in skim milk powder, and subsidies for liquid skim milk for feed purposes were abolished for cost-benefit reasons, something that also drew a lot of criticism.

lsp.reference: The definition of the eligible skimmed milk powder was clarified, the control procedures were reviewed in particular with regard to the proof of buttermilk in skimmed milk powder, and the subsidies for liquid skimmed milk for feeding purposes were abolished due to cost-benefit considerations, something that also sparked a lot of criticism.

lsp.judge: It is said there: "welcomes the European Central Bank's public commitment in its 1999 annual report to build a cooperative relationship with the European Anti-Fraud Office OLAF, but regrets the clear contradiction between the commitment publicly undertaken by the ECB in its 1999 annual report to build close cooperation with OLAF and the ECB's decision to prevent OLAF from conducting internal investigations, while the judgment of the European Court of Justice is still pending."

lsp.query: In der berühmt-berüchtigten Sonderzulage, die so viel Kritik ausgelöst hat, möchte ich anmerken, dass, wenn jeder Bedienstete der Europäischen Zentralbank pro Jahr Anrecht auf eine 9 %ige Gehaltszulage hat, die 38 %, die ihnen über einen Zeitraum von 54 Monaten gezahlt wurden, einem Satz von 8,5 % pro Jahr entsprechen.
lsp.judge: In the infamous special allowance, which has generated so much criticism, I would like to point out that if every employee of the European Central Bank is entitled to a 9% salary supplement per year, the 38% paid to them over a period of 54 months corresponds to a rate of 8.5% per year.

lsp.judge: Mr. President, Madam Commissioner, esteemed colleagues! lsp.query: Ich bin froh, dass dieser für die Entwicklung der kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen in Europa so bedeutsame Bericht derart gut verfasst worden ist, und ich wünsche mir, dass Herr Bushill-Matthews auch in Zukunft bei allen die KMU betreffenden Rechtsetzungsmaßnahmen der Europäischen Union sein herausragendes Können unter Beweis zu stellen vermag.
lsp.judge: I am pleased that this report, which is so important for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises in Europe, has been so well written, and I hope that Mr. Bushill-Matthews will continue to demonstrate his outstanding expertise in all EU legislative measures concerning SMEs.
lsp.proxy: I am pleased that this report, which is so significant for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises in Europe, has been written so well, and I wish that Mr. Bushill-Matthews will also be able to demonstrate his outstanding expertise in all future legislative measures of the European Union concerning SMEs.

lsp.query: Deshalb fordere ich Herrn Bushill-Matthews auf, sich in Zukunft daran zu erinnern - und die Frau Kommissarin Schreyer fordere ich auf, sich jetzt und in Zukunft daran zu erinnern -, dass es zusätzlich zu den in diesem Bericht vorgeschlagenen bedeutsamen Initiativen zweckmäßig wäre, die Mitgliedstaaten zu ersuchen und darauf zu dringen, die neu gegründeten Kleinunternehmen mindestens für die ersten fünf Jahre von der Steuerzahlung zu befreien.
lsp.judge: Therefore, I call on Mr. Bushill-Matthews to remember this in the future - and I call on Commissioner Schreyer to remember this now and in the future - that in addition to the important initiatives proposed in this report, it would be advisable to request and urge the Member States to exempt newly founded small businesses from paying taxes for at least the first five years.

lsp.query: Die Kommission sollte ein Projektmanagement vorschlagen, "Best Practice "-Methoden entwickeln, Benchmarks einführen, anhand derer überprüft wird, wie viel Zeit vom ersten Antrag bis zur erfolgreichen Schaffung von Arbeitsplätzen vergeht, die Zahlungsströme verfolgen und letztlich das Ganze in der Öffentlichkeit verkaufen.
lsp.judge: The commission should propose a project management plan, develop "best practice" methods, introduce benchmarks to track the time from the first application to the successful creation of jobs, monitor cash flows, and ultimately sell the whole thing to the public.
lsp.proxy: The Commission should propose a project management, develop "best practice" methods, introduce benchmarks to check how much time elapses from the initial application to the successful creation of jobs, track the payment flows, and ultimately sell the whole thing to the public.

lsp.query: Was die von allen drei Finanzinstrumenten der Initiative Wachstum und Beschäftigung am wenigsten in Anspruch genommene JEV-Fazilität anbetrifft, so sieht das Mehrjahresprogramm für Unternehmen hier eine Vereinfachung der Regelungen vor, damit Anträge von KMU auf finanzielle Unterstützung von den Finanzintermediären und den Diensten der Kommission schneller bearbeitet werden können.
lsp.judge: Regarding the JEV facility, which is the least utilized of the three financial instruments of the Growth and Employment Initiative, the multi-year program for companies proposes simplifying the regulations so that applications from SMEs for financial support from financial intermediaries and the services of the Commission can be processed more quickly.
lsp.proxy: As regards the JEREMIE facility, which is the least used of the three financial instruments of the Growth and Employment Initiative, the multi-annual programme for enterprises provides for a simplification of the rules so that applications from SMEs for financial support can be processed more quickly by financial intermediaries and the Commission's services.

lsp.query: Drittens sollte die Kommission bei sämtlichen bilateralen Steuervereinbarungen, die getroffen werden, sorgfältiger auf die Einhaltung des Grundsatzes des Beschäftigungslandes achten, dem zufolge die Steuergesetzgebung und die soziale Sicherheit zu koordinieren sind, um Problemen vorzubeugen und zu verhindern, dass die Arbeitnehmer zwischen zwei Stühlen sitzen.
lsp.judge: Thirdly, the Commission should be more careful in all bilateral tax agreements concluded to ensure compliance with the principle of the employment country, according to which tax legislation and social security should be coordinated to prevent problems and avoid workers being caught between two stools.
lsp.proxy: Thirdly, the Commission should pay closer attention to compliance with the principle of the country of employment in all bilateral tax agreements concluded, whereby tax legislation and social security are to be coordinated in order to prevent problems and prevent workers from falling between two stools.
lsp.reference: Thirdly, the Commission should be more careful in all bilateral tax agreements that are made to ensure compliance with the principle of the country of employment, according to which the tax legislation and social security are to be coordinated in order to prevent problems and to prevent workers from being caught between two stools.

lsp.query: Unterdessen bleibt die Welt nicht stehen und werden heute in verschiedenen Ländern Steuerreformen durchgeführt, ist die Gesetzgebung auf dem Gebiet der sozialen Sicherheit voll in Bewegung, werden die gesetzlichen Rentensysteme durch Zusatzrentensysteme ergänzt und werden in zahlreichen Ländern hinsichtlich des Ziels, Berufstätigkeit, Familie und Freizeit zu vereinbaren, diverse Regelungen für eine Unterbrechung der Beschäftigung ausgedacht, die dann nur für die eigenen Staatsangehörigen und leider nicht für die Grenzarbeitnehmer gelten.
lsp.judge: Meanwhile, the world does not stand still and while tax reforms are being implemented in various countries today, legislation in the field of social security is in full swing. Statutory pension systems are being supplemented by additional pension systems, and in numerous countries, various regulations for interrupting employment are being devised with the aim of reconciling work, family, and leisure time. These regulations, however, only apply to nationals and unfortunately not to cross-border workers.
lsp.proxy: Meanwhile, the world is not standing still, and today, tax reforms are being implemented in various countries, legislation in the field of social security is in full motion, statutory pension systems are being supplemented by additional pension systems, and in numerous countries, various regulations for interrupting employment are being devised to reconcile the goal of work, family, and leisure, which then only apply to their own citizens and unfortunately not to cross-border workers.
lsp.reference: Meanwhile, the world does not stand still and tax reforms are being implemented today in various countries, legislation in the field of social security is fully in motion, statutory pension systems are being supplemented by additional pension systems, and in numerous countries, various regulations have been devised regarding the goal of reconciling work, family, and leisure time, which only apply to their own citizens and unfortunately not to border workers.

lsp.query: Erstens: In dem Bericht Oomen-Ruijten wird völlig zu Recht die Forderung des Europäischen Parlaments nach Einführung einer Bewertung von Grenzauswirkungen erneuert, wonach die Mitgliedstaaten verpflichtet sind, bei Änderungen ihrer Rechtsvorschriften in den Bereichen soziale Sicherheit und Steuergesetzgebung die Auswirkungen für Grenzarbeitnehmer zu untersuchen, wobei den Grenzarbeitnehmern dadurch entstehende Nachteile ausgeglichen werden sollen, eine Regelung, die von einigen Mitgliedstaaten übrigens nur widerwillig angewandt wird.
lsp.judge: First: The Oomen-Ruijten report rightly reiterates the European Parliament's demand for the introduction of an assessment of border effects, according to which member states are obliged to examine the effects on cross-border workers when changing their legislation in the areas of social security and tax law, with any disadvantages arising for cross-border workers being offset, a regulation which is, by the way, only reluctantly applied by some member states.
lsp.proxy: Firstly: The Oomen-Ruijten report quite rightly reiterates the European Parliament's call for the introduction of an assessment of cross-border impacts, whereby Member States are required to examine the effects on cross-border workers when amending their legislation in the areas of social security and taxation, with a view to offsetting any disadvantages that may arise for cross-border workers, a provision that is, incidentally, applied only reluctantly by some Member States.
lsp.reference: Firstly: The Oomen-Ruijten report entirely rightly reiterates the European Parliament's demand for the introduction of an assessment of border impact effects, according to which member states are obliged to investigate the effects for border workers in the event of changes to their legislation in the areas of social security and tax legislation, where the resulting disadvantages for border workers are to be offset, a regulation that is, incidentally, only reluctantly applied by some member states.

lsp.query: Um eine qualitativ hochstehende Schulbildung zu sichern, sind genügend Schulen, Klassen mit einer begrenzten Schülerzahl, eine ausreichende Zahl von Lehrkräften, Lehrer und technisches sowie Verwaltungspersonal auf allen Unterrichtsstufen, angefangen von der Grundschule, erforderlich, denn in allen Ländern Europas beginnt gerade in den Grundschulklassen ein Differenzierungsprozess, der sich für die Kinder der weniger begüterten Schichten in einem vielfach nicht wieder auszugleichenden Bildungsrückstand äußert.
lsp.judge: To ensure a high-quality education, sufficient schools, classes with limited student numbers, an adequate number of teachers, and technical and administrative staff at all educational levels, starting from primary school, are required. This is because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins in primary school, which for children from less affluent backgrounds often results in an educational gap that is difficult to bridge.
lsp.proxy: To ensure a high-quality school education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teachers, instructors, and technical as well as administrative staff at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, are required, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins precisely in the elementary school classes, which for children from less affluent backgrounds often results in an educational disadvantage that cannot be compensated for in many cases.
lsp.reference: To ensure a high-quality education, sufficient schools, classes with a limited number of students, an adequate number of teaching staff, teachers, and technical as well as administrative personnel are required at all levels of instruction, starting from elementary school, because in all European countries, a differentiation process begins in elementary school classes, which manifests itself in a frequently irreparable educational backlog for the children of less affluent strata.

lsp.judge: Regarding my explanation on the vote on the Staes report concerning the Committee on Budgetary Control and specifically the EU aid for Bosnia and Herzegovina and the use of the related funds, I would like to mention that I had a meeting with representatives of the pensioners in this region.

lsp.query: (EL) Brutale militärische Interventionen im Namen des Friedens, unlautere "Friedens "Abkommen, die manu militari unterzeichnet worden sind, gefolgt von zweifelhaften, anrüchigen finanziellen "Hilfen " für die "Wiederherstellung des Friedens " - das sind die Errungenschaften, die die EU in Bosnien-Herzegowina, im Kosovo und generell auf dem Balkan vorzuweisen hat, einer Region, die schon seit Jahren Spielball gigantischer militärisch-politischer, imperialistischer Interessen und Machenschaften ist.
lsp.judge: Brutal military interventions in the name of peace, unscrupulous "peace" agreements signed at the point of a gun, followed by dubious, shady financial "aid" for the "restoration of peace" - these are the achievements that the EU can boast of in Bosnia-Herzegovina, Kosovo, and generally in the Balkans, a region that has been a plaything of gigantic military-political, imperialist interests and machinations for years.
lsp.proxy: Brutal military interventions in the name of peace, unfair "peace" agreements signed under duress, followed by dubious, shady financial "aid" for the "restoration of peace" - these are the achievements the EU can boast of in Bosnia-Herzegovina, in Kosovo, and generally in the Balkans, a region that has been a plaything of gigantic military-political, imperialist interests and machinations for years.
