lsp.reference: Until 31 December 2002, we still have two years in which we can think about and decide on a common policy. According to the European Commission's outline, 18 questions arise in this context, such as free or non-free access to community waters, control or management of the market for fishery and aquaculture products, international fishery agreements, scientific research activities regarding fish stocks, and the specificities of the Mediterranean area.

lsp.query: Der gemeinsame Entschließungsantrag zum "Balkan-Syndrom " dient lediglich dazu, die kriminelle Politik der NATO und der Europäischen Union zu bemänteln, die unter dem Vorwand, die Menschenrechte verteidigen zu wollen, in Jugoslawien interveniert haben und dadurch irreparable menschliche und materielle Schäden verursacht haben.
lsp.judge: The joint resolution on the "Balkan Syndrome" only serves to cover up the criminal policies of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of defending human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.
lsp.proxy: The joint resolution on the "Balkan Syndrome" merely serves to whitewash the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights, thereby causing irreparable human and material damage.
lsp.reference: The joint resolution motion on the "Balkan Syndrome" serves merely to whitewash the criminal policy of NATO and the European Union, which intervened in Yugoslavia under the pretext of wanting to defend human rights and thereby caused irreparable human and material damage.

lsp.query: . (FR) Dass den Armeen der größten Mächte seit zehn Jahren die Schädlichkeit von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran, auch für diejenigen, die sie einsetzen, bekannt ist, beweist nur, dass die Generalstäbe ihren eigenen Soldaten die gleiche Missachtung entgegenbringen wie der Zivilbevölkerung und den gegnerischen Streitkräften.
lsp.judge: That the armies of the greatest powers have known for ten years the harmfulness of depleted uranium munitions, even for those who use them, proves only that the general staffs show their own soldiers the same disregard as they do for the civilian population and the enemy forces.
lsp.proxy: That the armies of the greatest powers have known for ten years about the harmfulness of ammunition with depleted uranium, even for those who use it, only proves that the general staffs show the same disregard for their own soldiers as for the civilian population and the opposing forces.
lsp.reference: That the armies of the greatest powers have known for ten years the harmfulness of uranium-tipped ammunition, even for those who use it, proves only that the general staffs show the same contempt to their own soldiers as to the civilian population and the opposing forces.

lsp.query: Seit Beginn des Atomzeitalters mit dem Zweiten Weltkrieg sind die Gefahren und Vorsorgemaßnahmen wohl bekannt, die man beim Umgang mit Uran und anderen radioaktiven Stoffen beachten muss, weil es sich um ein hochtoxisches (chemisch und radiologisch toxisches) Element handelt, wenn man es einatmet oder aufnimmt, das auch genetisch gefährlich ist.
lsp.judge: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautions associated with handling uranium and other radioactive materials have been well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element if inhaled or absorbed, and it is also genetically dangerous.
lsp.proxy: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and precautionary measures that must be observed when handling uranium and other radioactive substances have been well known, as it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.
lsp.reference: Since the beginning of the atomic age with World War II, the dangers and preventive measures are well known that one must observe when handling uranium and other radioactive substances, because it is a highly toxic (chemically and radiologically toxic) element that is also genetically hazardous if inhaled or ingested.

lsp.query: Angesichts des Ausmaßes des Verbrechens gegen ganze Zivilbevölkerungen ist es dringend notwendig, die Hauptverantwortlichen für diese verbrecherischen Akte gegen die Menschlichkeit zu ermitteln, ihre Schuld festzustellen und sie zu verurteilen sowie die Herstellung, Erprobung, Benutzung und den Verkauf von Waffen mit abgereichertem Uran unverzüglich zu verbieten und nicht nur ein Moratorium anzunehmen.
lsp.judge: Given the scale of crimes against entire civilian populations, it is urgently necessary to identify the main perpetrators of these criminal acts against humanity, establish their guilt and condemn them, and to immediately prohibit the manufacture, testing, use, and sale of weapons with depleted uranium, and not just to accept a moratorium.
lsp.proxy: In view of the extent of the crime against entire civilian populations, it is urgently necessary to identify the main perpetrators of these criminal acts against humanity, to establish their guilt and to condemn them, as well as to immediately prohibit the production, testing, use and sale of weapons with depleted uranium and not just adopt a moratorium.
lsp.reference: In light of the scale of the crimes committed against entire civilian populations, it is urgently necessary to identify the main perpetrators of these heinous acts against humanity, to establish their guilt, and to condemn them, as well as to immediately prohibit the production, testing, use, and sale of uranium-enriched weapons and to adopt not only a moratorium.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, nach all den tragischen Geschehnissen im Zusammenhang mit der Bombardierung Jugoslawiens und nach den Enthüllungen über die Verwendung von Munition mit abgereichertem Uran ist es nunmehr dringend erforderlich, diese Art von Waffen zu verbieten, die selbst nach ihrem Einsatz noch über eine lange Zeit hinweg gefährliche Auswirkungen haben und blind, d. h. ohne erkennbaren Unterschied, all diejenigen treffen können, die Gefahr laufen, mit ihnen in Berührung zu kommen.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, after all the tragic events in connection with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium munitions, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which even after its use continues to have dangerous effects for a long time and indiscriminately, i.e. without any recognizable distinction, affects all those who are at risk of coming into contact with it.
lsp.proxy: Mr President, following all the tragic events connected with the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of ammunition with depleted uranium, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which even after use still has dangerous effects over a long period and strikes blindly, i.e. without distinction, all those who risk coming into contact with them.
lsp.reference: Mr. President, in light of the tragic events surrounding the bombing of Yugoslavia and the revelations about the use of depleted uranium ammunition, it is now urgently necessary to ban this type of weapon, which, even after its use, has hazardous effects for a long time and can, blind, i.e., without discernible distinction, affect all those who run the risk of coming into contact with them.

lsp.query: Ebenso wichtig und dringlich ist es, eine umfassende Politik der Hilfe, der Prävention und der Sanierung für all die Gebiete in Jugoslawien zu konzipieren, die unter den Folgen des Einsatzes dieser Geschosse zu leiden haben, um so die Volksgesundheit und die Umwelt schützen, Böden und Gewässer sanieren und eine stetige wirtschaftliche Entwicklung des Landes und der gesamten Region gewährleisten zu können.
lsp.judge: Equally important and urgent is the development of a comprehensive policy of aid, prevention, and remediation for all the areas in Yugoslavia that are suffering the consequences of the use of these munitions, in order to protect public health and the environment, remediate soils and water, and ensure sustainable economic development of the country and the entire region.
lsp.proxy: It is equally important and urgent to conceive a comprehensive policy of assistance, prevention, and rehabilitation for all areas in Yugoslavia that are suffering from the consequences of the use of these munitions, in order to protect public health and the environment, rehabilitate soils and waters, and ensure the steady economic development of the country and the entire region.
lsp.reference: It is equally important and urgent to design a comprehensive policy of aid, prevention, and rehabilitation for all the areas in Yugoslavia that are suffering from the consequences of the use of these munitions, in order to protect public health and the environment, to restore soils and waters, and to ensure a steady economic development of the country and the entire region.

lsp.query: Abschließend möchte ich meine Ratlosigkeit angesichts der politischen Kehrtwende zum Ausdruck bringen, die bei unserer Aussprache zutage getreten ist. Während uns seinerzeit einige vorhielten, unsere Kritik an Milosevics Politik diene der NATO und ihren Bombardements, wirft uns Herr Solana heute vor, wir würden bei unseren Vorbehalten gegenüber dem abgereicherten Uran die Menschenrechte der Opfer von Milosevic vergessen.
lsp.judge: Finally, I would like to express my bewilderment at the political about-face that has emerged during our discussion. While some people accused us at the time of using our criticism of Milosevic's policies to serve NATO and its bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic in our reservations about depleted uranium.
lsp.proxy: In conclusion, I would like to express my bewilderment at the political about-face that has emerged during our discussion. While some people previously accused us that our criticism of Milosevic's policy served the interests of NATO and its bombing campaigns, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic due to our reservations regarding depleted uranium.
lsp.reference: In conclusion, I would like to express my bewilderment in the face of the political U-turn that has become apparent in our discussion. While some of us were accused at the time of using our criticism of Milosevic's policy to serve the interests of NATO and their bombings, Mr. Solana now accuses us of forgetting the human rights of the victims of Milosevic in our reservations about the enriched uranium.

lsp.query: Ich habe im letzten Jahr außerdem mit Sorge beobachtet, dass die derzeitige russische Führung - zu der viele ehemalige KGB-Mitarbeiter gehören, die von Präsident Putin, der ja früher selbst KGB-Oberst war, berufen wurden - großen Eifer bei der Verhaftung so genannter britischer, amerikanischer und russischer Spione an den Tag gelegt hat.
lsp.judge: Last year, I also observed with concern that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB officers appointed by President Putin, who himself was formerly a KGB colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
lsp.proxy: I also observed with concern last year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees appointed by President Putin, who was himself a former KGB colonel - has shown great zeal in arresting so-called British, American, and Russian spies.
lsp.reference: I have also been observing with concern in the past year that the current Russian leadership - which includes many former KGB employees who were appointed by President Putin, who was himself a KGB colonel in the past - has shown great zeal in the arrest of so-called British, American, and Russian spies.

lsp.query: Ich befürchte, dass auch dieses Jahr meine Partei, die Radikale Partei, leider wieder zu den wenigen gehören wird, die mit Wei Jinsheng und einigen anderen die Menschenrechte in China und in Tibet verteidigen, die die Tschetschenienfrage mit Nachdruck ansprechen werden, während der Rat und die von ihm vertretene Union in der UNO wieder einmal nicht in Erscheinung treten werden.
lsp.judge: I fear that this year, too, my party, the Radical Party, will unfortunately be among the few that, along with Wei Jinsheng and some others, will defend human rights in China and Tibet, and will press for a solution to the Chechen question, while the Council and the Union it represents in the UN will once again fail to make an appearance.
lsp.proxy: I fear that this year, too, my party, the Radical Party, will unfortunately again be among the few who, along with Wei Jinsheng and a few others, will defend human rights in China and Tibet, who will forcefully address the Chechnya issue, while the Council and the Union it represents will once again fail to make an appearance at the UN.
lsp.reference: I fear that this year as well, my party, the Radical Party, unfortunately will again be among the few who, along with Wei Jinsheng and a few others, will defend human rights in China and in Tibet, who will address the Chechen issue with emphasis, while the Council and the Union it represents will once again not make an appearance in the UN.

lsp.query: Ich sage das eingedenk des Völkermords in Ruanda im Jahre 1994, wo die Völkergemeinschaft mit ansehen musste, wie Hunderttausende Menschen ermordet wurden. Im Hinblick auf Zentralafrika möchte ich darauf drängen, dass die Europäische Union energischer handelt und auch die Vereinten Nationen größere Wachsamkeit zeigen.
lsp.judge: I say this in remembrance of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. With regard to Central Africa, I would like to urge the European Union to act more decisively and for the United Nations to show greater vigilance.
lsp.proxy: I say this in light of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to watch as hundreds of thousands of people were murdered. With regard to Central Africa, I would like to urge the European Union to take more energetic action and the United Nations to show greater vigilance.
lsp.reference: I say this mindful of the genocide in Rwanda in 1994, where the international community had to witness the murder of hundreds of thousands of people. In light of Central Africa, I would like to urge that the European Union takes more decisive action and that the United Nations displays greater vigilance.

lsp.query: Selbstverständlich, Herr Präsident, stimme ich der Kritik an China wegen Tibet, an Russland wegen Tschetschenien, der Kritik wegen Menschenrechtsverletzungen in dem Konflikt zwischen Israel und den Palästinensern sowie der Kritik an dieser widerwärtigen öffentlichen Exekution zu, die stattgefunden hat.
lsp.judge: Of course, Mr. President, I agree with the criticism of China regarding Tibet, of Russia regarding Chechnya, the criticism regarding human rights violations in the conflict between Israel and the Palestinians, and the criticism of this abhorrent public execution that took place.
lsp.proxy: Of course, Mr. President, I concur with the criticism of China regarding Tibet, of Russia regarding Chechnya, the criticism of human rights abuses in the conflict between Israel and the Palestinians, as well as the criticism of this repulsive public execution that took place.
lsp.reference: Of course, Mr. President, I agree with the criticism of China over Tibet, of Russia over Chechnya, the criticism over human rights violations in the conflict between Israel and the Palestinians, and the criticism of this detestable public execution that took place.

lsp.query: (Beifall) Zweitens: Wir fordern Sie auf, schon ziemlich schnell - die Vorbereitungen müssen unter Ihrer Präsidentschaft beginnen und sollten dann in Laken unter belgischer Präsidentschaft zu einem Beschluss führen - eine Konferenz einzusetzen, die sich an der Methodik und an dem Modell des Konventes orientiert, unter starker Beteiligung des Europäischen Parlaments und natürlich der nationalen Regierungen, vor allen Dingen aber auch der Kommission.
lsp.judge: (Applause) Secondly: We call on you to convene a conference fairly soon - the preparations must begin under your presidency and should then, under Belgian presidency, lead to a decision - a conference that is oriented towards the methodology and model of the Convention, with strong involvement of the European Parliament and of course the national governments, but above all also the Commission.
lsp.proxy: (Applause) Secondly: We urge you to set up a conference, fairly quickly - the preparations must begin under your presidency and should then lead to a decision in Laeken under Belgian presidency - which is based on the methodology and the model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, but above all also the Commission.
lsp.reference: (Applause) Secondly, we call on you to start preparations quite quickly - under your presidency, they should lead to a decision in Laken under Belgian presidency - to convene a conference that is oriented towards the methodology and model of the Convention, with strong participation of the European Parliament and, of course, the national governments, above all, however, also the Commission.

lsp.query: Wir sehen mit großer Sorge, dass es, auch durch das Handeln des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats - und Herr Solana, den ich hoch schätze, kümmert sich ja mehr um die Aufgabe des Hohen Vertreters - an der Spitze des Generalsekretariats des Ministerrats manche Abschottungen gibt, dass man weder der Kommission noch dem Europäischen Parlament Informationen geben will.
lsp.judge: We are seeing with great concern that, also through the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly esteem, is, after all, more concerned with the task of the High Representative - there are some blockades at the head of the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers, that neither the Commission nor the European Parliament is being given information.
lsp.proxy: We are deeply concerned to see that, also due to the actions of the General Secretariat of the Council - and Mr Solana, whom I hold in high esteem, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - at the head of the General Secretariat of the Council, there are certain barriers, in that one is unwilling to provide either the Commission or the European Parliament with information.
lsp.reference: We see with great concern that, even through the actions of the Council Secretariat - and Mr. Solana, whom I highly esteem, is indeed more concerned with the task of the High Representative - there are some exclusions at the top of the Council Secretariat, that one does not want to give information to either the Commission or the European Parliament.

lsp.query: Das nächste Thema, das die schwedische Präsidentschaft und das uns alle vom soeben begonnenen Jahr 2001 bis zum Jahr 2004 beschäftigen wird - das sind vier Jahre mit vielen Wahlen, einschließlich der europäischen - ist das Thema "Post-Nizza".
lsp.judge: The next topic that will occupy the Swedish Presidency and all of us from the year 2001, which has just begun, until 2004 - four years with many elections, including the European ones - is the topic "Post-Nice".

lsp.query: Frau Präsidentin, Herr Ratspräsident, Herr Kommissionspräsident, werte Kollegen! Ich trage zwar zufällig heute die Nizza-Krawatte, komme aber dennoch nicht umhin festzustellen, dass wir wie schon in Amsterdam in Nizza erneut erleben mussten, dass die Regierungskonferenz als Instrument am Ende ist.
lsp.judge: Madam President, Mr. President of the Council, Mr. President of the Commission, dear colleagues! Although I happen to be wearing the Nice tie today, I cannot help but observe that, as in Amsterdam, we have once again had to experience in Nice that the government conference as an instrument has come to an end.
lsp.proxy: Madam President, Mr. President of the Council, Mr. President of the Commission, esteemed colleagues! Although I am coincidentally wearing a Nice tie today, I still cannot help but note that, just as in Amsterdam, we had to experience once again in Nice that the Intergovernmental Conference as an instrument has reached its limits.
lsp.reference: Honorable President, Mr. Chairman, Mr. Commission President, esteemed colleagues! I may be wearing the Nice tie by chance today, but I still cannot help but notice that, just as we experienced in Amsterdam, we have once again had to realize in Nice that the government conference is ultimately a tool.

lsp.query: Als Vertreter der Völker und der Regionen sehen wir in Schweden einen Verbündeten bei der Verteidigung von für uns wichtigen Werten, zu denen die sprachliche und kulturelle Vielfalt zählt. Wenn Sie nun aber von einer stärkeren Beteiligung der nationalen Parlamente sprechen, so möchten wir, dass den Institutionen unserer verfassungsmäßig anerkannten Regionen, unseren Regionalregierungen, die gleiche Beachtung geschenkt wird.
lsp.judge: As representatives of the peoples and regions, we see Sweden as an ally in the defense of values that are important to us, including linguistic and cultural diversity. However, when you speak of increased involvement of national parliaments, we want the institutions of our constitutionally recognized regions, our regional governments, to be given the same consideration.
lsp.proxy: As representatives of the peoples and regions, we see Sweden as an ally in defending values that are important to us, including linguistic and cultural diversity. However, when you speak of a stronger involvement of national parliaments, we want the institutions of our constitutionally recognized regions, our regional governments, to receive the same attention.
lsp.reference: As representatives of the peoples and the regions, we see Sweden as an ally in the defense of values that are important to us, including linguistic and cultural diversity. However, if you now speak of a stronger involvement of national parliaments, we would like the same consideration to be given to the institutions of our constitutionally recognized regions, our regional governments.

lsp.query: Beim Thema Erweiterung schließlich sehen wir das Wichtigste nicht lediglich in der Übernahme des materiellen gemeinschaftlichen Besitzstandes, sondern fordern, dass der Schwerpunkt auf den ethischen Acquis Communautaire gelegt wird, d. h. an erster Stelle auf Demokratie, Achtung der Menschenrechte und der Minderheiten, damit Europa wirklich eine Wertegemeinschaft, kurzum eine Gemeinschaft darstellen kann.
lsp.judge: Finally, on the subject of enlargement, we see the most important thing not merely in the acquisition of the material common property, but demand that the focus be placed on the ethical Acquis Communautaire, i.e., first and foremost on democracy, respect for human rights and minorities, so that Europe can truly be a community of values, in short, a community.
lsp.proxy: On the issue of expansion, we do not see the most important thing merely in the adoption of the material community acquis, but demand that the focus be placed on the ethical acquis communautaire, i.e. on democracy, respect for human rights and minorities first and foremost, so that Europe can truly represent a community of values, in short, a community.
lsp.reference: When it comes to the topic of expansion, we ultimately see the most important thing not just in taking over the material community's assets, but we demand that the focus be placed on the ethical Acquis Communautaire, i.e., first and foremost on democracy, respect for human rights and minorities, so that Europe can truly be a community of values, in short, a community.

lsp.query: Ebenso wie einige andere Redner des heutigen Tages bin auch ich beunruhigt über die Tendenz, das zwischenstaatliche Modell oft und nachdrücklich auf Kosten des so genannten Community Approach hervorzuheben, der der Kommission eine stärkere Rolle und Bedeutung zuweist.
lsp.judge: Just like some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to emphasize the inter-state model often and strongly at the expense of the so-called Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and importance to the Commission.
lsp.proxy: Like some other speakers today, I am also concerned about the tendency to often and emphatically emphasize the inter-state model at the expense of the so-called Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and significance to the Commission.
lsp.reference: Just like some other speakers of today, I am also concerned about the trend of often and emphatically highlighting the inter-state model at the expense of what is called the Community Approach, which assigns a stronger role and significance to the Commission.

lsp.query: Wenn es Ihnen gelingt, Ihre Landsleute davon zu überzeugen, dass der Euro ein gutes Projekt ist, dass er nach innen stabil ist, dass seine Stabilität nach außen auch immer besser wird, wenn Sie sie davon überzeugen können, dieses große Werk der europäischen Integration mitzutragen, tragen Sie damit auch dazu bei, dass dieser Bereich der Europäischen Union auch von den Bürgern besser verstanden werden kann.
lsp.judge: If you succeed in convincing your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its external stability is also constantly improving, if you can convince them to contribute to this great project of European integration, you will also be contributing to the fact that this area of the European Union is better understood by its citizens.
lsp.proxy: If you succeed in convincing your fellow citizens that the euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its external stability is also constantly improving, if you can convince them to support this major work of European integration, you will also contribute to this area of the European Union being better understood by its citizens.
lsp.reference: If you succeed in convincing your fellow countrymen that the Euro is a good project, that it is stable internally, that its stability will also improve externally, and if you can convince them to contribute to this great work of European integration, you will also contribute to the fact that this area of the European Union can be better understood by its citizens.

lsp.query: Gleichzeitig verkündet der Europarat, dass die Folter weiterhin in den Polizeirevieren der Türkei an der Tagesordnung ist, und Amnesty International verurteilt die Folter, die Nichtbestrafung der Verantwortlichen und generell die Verstöße gegen die Menschenrechte seitens der Türkei und fordert die Europäische Union auf, zu verlangen, dass die Folter unverzüglich eingestellt wird, und nicht erst 2002­2003, wie in dem Verfahren für den Beitritt der Türkei zur Europäischen Union vorgesehen.
lsp.judge: At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture continues to be commonplace in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, and calls on the European Union to demand that torture be stopped immediately, and not in 2002-2003, as foreseen in the procedure for Turkey's accession to the European Union.
lsp.proxy: At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still a daily occurrence in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the impunity of those responsible, and the general human rights violations by Turkey, and calls on the European Union to demand that torture be stopped immediately, and not just in 2002-2003, as provided for in the procedure for Turkey's accession to the European Union.
lsp.reference:
# English
At the same time, the Council of Europe announces that torture is still on the agenda in Turkish police stations, and Amnesty International condemns the torture, the non-prosecution of those responsible, and generally the human rights violations by Turkey, and demands that the European Union call for torture to be immediately stopped, and not just in 2002-2003, as provided for in the accession procedure for Turkey's entry into the European Union.

lsp.query: Ich möchte jedoch noch einige weiterführende Fragen stellen: Es geht mir um die de facto existierende politische Union zwischen Weißrussland und Polen sowie die Frage, inwieweit die schwedische Ratspräsidentschaft bereit ist, auch auf Russland Druck auszuüben, das ebenfalls Teil einer politischen Union mit Weißrussland ist. Inwieweit erkennt sie die Folgen für die Demokratie und die Stellung Russlands in der Weltgemeinschaft, die durch die Union mit einem Land erwachsen, das wohl kaum als Demokratie zu bezeichnen ist?
lsp.judge: However, I would like to ask some further questions: I am concerned about the de facto existing political union between Belarus and Poland, and the question of to what extent the Swedish Presidency is willing to exert pressure on Russia, which is also part of a political union with Belarus. To what extent does it recognize the consequences for democracy and Russia's standing in the international community that arise from the union with a country that can hardly be described as a democracy?
lsp.proxy: I would, however, like to ask a few more in-depth questions: I am concerned about the de facto existing political union between Belarus and Poland, as well as the question of to what extent the Swedish Presidency of the Council is willing to also exert pressure on Russia, which is also part of a political union with Belarus. To what extent does it recognize the consequences for democracy and Russia's position in the international community that arise from the union with a country that can hardly be described as a democracy?
lsp.reference: I would like to pose some further questions, however: It's about the de facto existing political union between Belarus and Poland, as well as the question of how far the Swedish presidency is willing to exert pressure on Russia, which is also part of a political union with Belarus. To what extent does it acknowledge the consequences for democracy and Russia's position in the international community, which arise from the union with a country that can hardly be described as a democracy?

lsp.query: Die Union hat u. a. auf der letzten Ministerratstagung der ASEAN-Staaten in Vientiane im Dezember 2000 ihre Erwartung deutlich gemacht, dass die EU-Troika die gleichen Möglichkeiten der Kontaktaufnahme zu allen beteiligten Parteien erhält, seien es nun Vertreter der Regierung, der National League for Democracy oder ethnischer Minderheiten.
lsp.judge: The Union made it clear at the last ASEAN ministerial meeting in Vientiane in December 2000 that it expects the EU Troika to have the same opportunities for contact with all parties involved, whether they be representatives of the government, the National League for Democracy, or ethnic minorities.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson, Frau Kommissarin! Nachdem ich soeben die Nachrichten gesehen hatte, hoffte ich - und eigentlich sah es auch fast danach aus -, wir würden eine Aussprache über fox hunting führen, worüber es heute Abend zweifellos eine äußerst lebhafte Debatte im britischen Parlament geben wird.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson, Commissioner! After I had just seen the news, I hoped - and actually it almost looked that way - that we would have a discussion about fox hunting, which will undoubtedly be the subject of a very lively debate in the British Parliament this evening.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, Herr Simpson hat wirklich einen ausgezeichneten Bericht vorgelegt. Ich kann das behaupten, weil ich wohl zu den wenigen gehöre, die nicht nur politisch, sondern auch fachlich mit diesem Sektor vertraut sind, denn bevor ich mich meiner Tätigkeit als Abgeordneter dieses Parlaments zuwandte, hatte ich etwa 10 000 Flugstunden als Mitglied einer Cockpitbesatzung absolviert.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, Mr. Simpson has indeed presented an excellent report. I can say that because I am probably one of the few who are familiar with this sector not only politically but also professionally, because before I turned to my work as a Member of this Parliament, I had completed about 10,000 flight hours as a member of a cockpit crew.

lsp.query: Ich weise Sie darauf hin, dass die Sicherheit das A und O des Luftverkehrs ist, wobei zu beachten ist, dass diese Sicherheit auf zwei Faktoren beruht: zum einen auf dem technischen Faktor, das heißt den Ausrüstungen, Flugzeugen, Flughäfen, Funknavigations- und Flugleiteinrichtungen usw., und zum anderen auf dem äußerst bedeutsamen menschlichen Faktor, der zwar keinen entscheidenden, aber doch einen sehr hohen Anteil an den Flugzeugunglücken hat.
lsp.judge: I would like to point out that safety is paramount in air travel, and this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, namely the equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, while not decisive, still plays a very significant role in aviation accidents.
lsp.proxy: I would like to point out that safety is the top priority in air traffic, with the understanding that this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, i.e. the equipment, aircraft, airports, radio navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely significant human factor, which, although not decisive, has a very high share in aircraft accidents.
lsp.reference: I would like to draw your attention to the fact that safety is the A and O of air traffic, where it is worth noting that this safety is based on two factors: on the one hand, the technical factor, that is to say the equipment, aircraft, airports, navigation and air traffic control facilities, etc., and on the other hand, the extremely important human factor, which, although it does not have a decisive share, yet has a very high share in aircraft accidents.

lsp.query: Entweder einigen sich die Parteien bis zum Mai, oder wir erwarten, dass die Kommission einen Vorschlag macht, den wir in die zweite Lesung einbauen können, denn es geht nicht an, dass die entscheidende Frage für die Sicherheit der Passagiere, nämlich, ob die Kapitäne, die Besatzungen, so ausgeruht sind, dass sie ihre Aufgaben wahrnehmen können, nicht geregelt wird.
lsp.judge: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is unacceptable that the crucial question of passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crews are sufficiently rested to perform their duties, remains unresolved.
lsp.proxy: Either the parties agree by May, or we expect the Commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it is unacceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether captains and crews are rested enough to perform their duties, is not regulated.
lsp.reference: Either the parties will agree by May, or we expect the commission to make a proposal that we can incorporate into the second reading, because it's not acceptable that the crucial question for passenger safety, namely whether the captains and crews are so well-rested that they can perform their duties, is not regulated.

lsp.query: Davon ausgehend verfolgt die von uns vorgeschlagene Änderung zur bestehenden Verordnung ein zweifaches Ziel: Zum einen zielt sie auf die weitere Harmonisierung des Regulierungssystems im Bereich der Sicherheit der Zivilluftfahrt durch seine Ausdehnung auf die Harmonisierung der Betriebsanforderungen für Luftfahrzeuge; zum anderen geht es um die Festlegung von Verfahren, die es der Gemeinschaft ermöglichen, die Varianten und die Ausnahmen zu bearbeiten, die die Mitgliedstaaten hin und wieder aus operativen Erfordernissen anwenden müssen.
lsp.judge: Based on this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation aims at two objectives: firstly, it aims to further harmonize the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to harmonize the operational requirements for aircraft; secondly, it is about establishing procedures that enable the Community to handle the variations and exemptions that Member States occasionally have to apply for operational reasons.
lsp.proxy: Based on this, the amendment we propose to the existing regulation has a twofold objective: on the one hand, it aims to further harmonise the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety by extending it to the harmonisation of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that will enable the Community to process the variants and exemptions that Member States must apply from time to time for operational reasons.
lsp.reference:
# English
Starting from this, the proposed amendment to the existing regulation pursues a twofold objective: On the one hand, it aims at further harmonization of the regulatory system in the field of civil aviation safety through its extension to the harmonization of operational requirements for aircraft; on the other hand, it is about establishing procedures that enable the community to handle the variants and exceptions that Member States occasionally have to apply from operational requirements.

lsp.query: Hinsichtlich des konkreten Problems der Thrombose - die jemand von Ihnen angesprochen hat - hat die Kommission die Luftverkehrsgesellschaften schriftlich aufgefordert, die Fluggäste über die Gefahren, Prädispositionsfaktoren und die Maßnahmen zur Minimierung dieser Risiken, konkret im Zusammenhang mit der Thrombose und den gesundheitlichen Problemen im Allgemeinen zu informieren.
lsp.judge: Regarding the specific problem of thrombosis - which someone of you has raised - the Commission has written to the airlines, asking them to inform passengers about the dangers, predisposing factors, and measures to minimize these risks, specifically in connection with thrombosis and general health problems.

lsp.query: Außerdem können auch andere, in dem Bericht erwähnte Vorschläge, wie die stärkere Unterstützung des europäischen Programms zur Bewertung von Neufahrzeugen, die Förderung von Kampagnen zugunsten der Verwendung von Sicherheitsgurten, die Entwicklung von Telematiksystemen sowie der obligatorische Einbau von Tagesfahrlichtern in Motorrädern und Fahrzeugen, relativ kostengünstig mit hohem Nutzen für die Straßenverkehrssicherheit und die Volksgesundheit verwirklicht werden.
lsp.judge: Furthermore, other suggestions mentioned in the report, such as strengthening support for the European program for evaluating new vehicles, promoting campaigns in favor of the use of seat belts, developing telematics systems, and the mandatory installation of daytime running lights in motorcycles and vehicles, can be implemented relatively cost-effectively with high benefits for road safety and public health.

lsp.query: Herr Präsident, in erster Linie möchte ich Frau Hedkvist Petersen aufrichtig zu ihrem allumfassenden Entschließungsantrag beglückwünschen, den sie zur Sicherheit des Straßenverkehrs ausgearbeitet hat und der das Interesse des Europäischen Parlaments - das sich heute auch in Ihren Reden gezeigt hat - an einer ehrgeizigen Politik zur Bekämpfung des Übels der Verkehrsunfälle beweist.
lsp.judge: Mr. President, first and foremost, I would like to sincerely congratulate Ms. Hedkvist Petersen on her comprehensive resolution, which she has drafted for road safety and which demonstrates the interest of the European Parliament – as has also been shown in your speeches today – in an ambitious policy to combat the scourge of road accidents.

Ich nehme an, dass Sie einen anderen Standpunkt vertreten - ich habe das schon bemerkt -, und es ist überdies natürlich eine Tatsache, dass es bis jetzt keine ausreichende Mehrheit im Rat gegeben hat, um eine derartige Initiative auf den Weg zu bringen.

lsp.query: Analysiert man die Reibungskosten im intermodalen Güterverkehr im Einzelnen, so ist festzustellen, dass die Hauptproblempunkte gegenüber dem traditionellen unimodalen Verkehr in höheren Preisen, längeren Fahrzeiten, zunehmenden von den Gütern zurückgelegten durchschnittlichen Entfernungen, Qualitätsminderung, größeren Beschädigungsrisiken, Beschränkungen bezüglich der Art der beförderten Güter sowie komplexeren Verwaltungsverfahren liegen.
lsp.judge: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail reveals that the main problem points compared to traditional unimodal transport are higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by goods, quality deterioration, higher damage risks, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
lsp.proxy: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail reveals that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, reduced quality, greater risk of damage, restrictions on the type of goods transported, and more complex administrative procedures.
lsp.reference: Analyzing the friction costs in intermodal freight transport in detail, it can be determined that the main problem areas compared to traditional unimodal transport lie in higher prices, longer travel times, increasing average distances covered by the goods, quality degradation, greater damage risks, restrictions on the type of goods being transported, and more complex administrative procedures.

lsp.query: Schließlich kennzeichnet eine Reihe von Hindernissen, verursacht durch mangelnde Harmonisierung der Fristen und Zeitpläne zwischen den einzelnen Verkehrsträgern, das gesamte System, wodurch es zu Unvereinbarkeiten zwischen den mit der Gütertransportkette verknüpften Erfordernissen und den operativen Erfordernissen der im Prozess eingesetzten Ressourcen kommt: So sind beispielsweise die Arbeitszeiten der Fahrer und Besatzungen nicht auf die intermodalen Operationen abgestimmt und die Terminals können sich nicht immer den auf einem 24-Stunden-Dienst beruhenden Zug- und Schiffsplänen anpassen.
lsp.judge: Finally, a number of obstacles, caused by a lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between the individual modes of transport, characterize the entire system, leading to inconsistencies between the requirements associated with the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not aligned with intermodal operations and terminals cannot always adapt to the train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.
lsp.proxy: Ultimately, a series of obstacles caused by the lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between the individual modes of transport characterize the entire system, resulting in incompatibilities between the requirements associated with the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not coordinated with intermodal operations, and terminals cannot always adapt to train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.

In the end, a series of obstacles, caused by a lack of harmonization of deadlines and schedules between individual modes of transport, characterizes the entire system, resulting in incompatibilities between the requirements linked to the goods transport chain and the operational requirements of the resources used in the process: For example, the working hours of drivers and crews are not adjusted to intermodal operations and terminals cannot always adapt to train and ship schedules based on a 24-hour service.

lsp.query: In ihrem Bericht "Intermodalität und intermodaler Güterverkehr in der Europäischen Union " hatte die Kommission die im intermodalen Verkehr zu erreichenden Ziele aufgezeigt und sie entsprechend der spezifischen Probleme in drei vorrangige Interventionsbereiche, so genannte Schlüsselaktionen unterteilt. Die erste Schlüsselaktion betrifft die Integration von Infrastruktur und Transportmitteln, die zweite die Interoperabilität und den Verbundbetrieb und die dritte die verkehrsträgerunabhängigen Dienste und Vorschriften.
lsp.judge: In her report "Intermodality and Intermodal Freight Transport in the European Union," the Commission outlined the goals to be achieved in intermodal transport and, in line with the specific problems, divided them into three priority intervention areas, so-called key actions. The first key action concerns the integration of infrastructure and transport modes, the second interoperability and combined operation, and the third transport-mode-independent services and regulations.

lsp.query: Die Kommissionsmitteilung und der Bericht haben viele, ja alle wichtigen Problempunkte zur Sprache gebracht. lsp.query: Zur Frage der Intermodalität bei der Überquerung der Alpen ist festzustellen, dass, abgesehen von der Entscheidung der Schweiz zugunsten erheblicher Investitionen im Eisenbahnsektor, ein Besorgnis erregender Rückstand beim Bau der anderen Verkehrsachsen und neuen Eisenbahntunnel besteht, die bereits von der Gemeinschaft geplant wurden, wie die Achse Turin-Lyon-Brenner, oder in der Diskussion sind, wie die Achse Aosta-Martigny.
lsp.judge: Regarding the issue of intermodality for crossing the Alps, it must be stated that, apart from Switzerland's decision in favor of significant investments in the rail sector, there is a worrying backlog in the construction of other transport axes and new railway tunnels that have already been planned by the community, such as the Turin-Lyon-Brenner axis, or are under discussion, such as the Aosta-Martigny axis.

lsp.query: Der Beitrag, den wir somit leisten, hat zwei Konsequenzen, die ich hier hervorheben möchte: Erstens werden wir, wenn wir dank der Methodik, die wir hoffentlich von der Kommission vorgelegt bekommen und akzeptieren können, eine klarere Definition und Anlastung der internen und externen Kosten an die Nutzer erreichen, die Voraussetzungen dafür schaffen, die Finanzierung der Infrastruktur, die gegenwärtig durch die öffentliche Hand gesichert wird bzw. über die allgemeine Besteuerung erfolgt, auf die Benutzer als solche zu verlagern.
lsp.judge: The contribution we thus make has two consequences, which I would like to highlight here: Firstly, if we, thanks to the methodology, which we hopefully will receive and be able to accept from the Commission, achieve a clearer definition and allocation of internal and external costs to the users, we will create the prerequisites for shifting the financing of the infrastructure, which is currently secured by the public sector or through general taxation, to the users themselves.

lsp.query: Wenn mir ein gewisser Vergleich mit der Diskussion erlaubt ist, die vor dem Hintergrund der Probleme im Zusammenhang mit der Nahrungsmittelsicherheit über die Reform der Agrarpolitik gegenwärtig nicht nur in Deutschland, sondern auch in einigen weiteren Mitgliedstaaten - mein Land zählt dazu - geführt wird, so prophezeie ich Ihnen angesichts der heutigen Umweltprobleme - trotz gescheiterter Klimakonferenzen - eine ähnliche Situation auch im Bereich der Verkehrspolitik.
lsp.judge: If a certain comparison with the discussion, which is currently taking place against the background of the problems associated with food security, regarding the reform of agricultural policy, is permitted, not only in Germany but also in some other member states - my country included - then I predict, in light of today's environmental problems - despite failed climate conferences - a similar situation also in the field of transport policy.

lsp.query: Um es nicht dazu kommen zu lassen, darf unser Ziel nicht darin bestehen, die Verkehrsinfrastrukturkosten zu minimieren, um somit möglichst wenig Kosten anzulasten, sondern wir müssen den Verkehrsbetreibern eine entsprechende Rechtsgrundlage bieten, damit sie die verursachten Kosten der Gruppe anlasten können, die dafür aufzukommen haben, nämlich den Endnutzern.
lsp.judge: In order to prevent this from happening, our goal should not be to minimize transportation infrastructure costs in order to impose as few costs as possible, but we must provide transport operators with the appropriate legal basis so that they can charge the costs incurred to the group responsible for them, namely the end users.

lsp.query: Ich möchte die von uns allen mitgetragenen Schwerpunkte noch einmal nennen: Kostenaufteilung in einem direkteren Verhältnis zur Nutzung der Infrastrukturen; Berücksichtigung der sozialen Kosten, aber auch Schutz benachteiligter Gebiete und Bevölkerungsgruppen; Förderung der Umweltverträglichkeit, aber gleichzeitig auch Durchsetzung des Rechts auf Mobilität als Universalrecht.
lsp.judge: I would like to reiterate the key points that we have all agreed on: cost allocation in a more direct relationship to the use of infrastructure; consideration of social costs, but also protection of disadvantaged areas and population groups; promotion of environmental compatibility, but at the same time enforcement of the right to mobility as a universal right.

lsp.query: Heute befinden sich die Beschäftigten des Unternehmens, zumindest in Frankreich, im Streik, und ich möchte in Erwartung Ihrer Antwort hinsichtlich des Ausschusses diesen Arbeitnehmern unsere Solidarität bekunden, denn es ist eine Schande, dass ein Konzern, der Milliarden Gewinne macht, Tausende von Arbeitnehmern in ganz Europa in die Arbeitslosigkeit und ins Elend schickt.

lsp.query: Die soziale Infrastruktur zur Seniorenbetreuung ist auszubauen, und schließlich müssen die Mitgliedstaaten bei der nächsten Regierungskonferenz den Vertrag dahingehend ändern, dass eine solide gesetzliche Basis geschaffen wird, die eine ausgewogene Mitwirkung beider Geschlechter in den institutionellen Organen der Europäischen Union sicherstellt, damit endlich das Selbstverständliche Realität wird, also das natürliche Gleichgewicht der Geschlechter auch in den Machtzentren seinen Niederschlag findet und jedwede die Zukunft Europas betreffenden Entscheidungen nicht ohne Einbeziehung der Frauen gefällt werden.
lsp.judge: The social infrastructure for senior care needs to be expanded, and ultimately, the member states must change the treaty at the next government conference so that a solid legal basis is created that ensures balanced participation of both genders in the institutional organs of the European Union, so that the self-evident becomes a reality, namely that the natural gender balance also finds its expression in the centers of power, and that any decisions concerning the future of Europe are not made without the involvement of women.

lsp.query: Frau Karamanou, ich glaube nicht, dass die schwache Vertretung der Frauen oder auch der Jugendlichen in unseren Parlamenten auf ein Übermaß an Demokratie zurückzuführen ist, sondern auf ein Demokratiedefizit, und die Wahllisten, die von den Parteien aufgestellt werden - die sogar, wie Sie es in Ihrem Bericht empfehlen, als Listen mit einer Quotenregelung aufgestellt werden, wo es nicht einmal mehr möglich ist, eine Vorzugsstimme abzugeben - bilden ein hervorragendes System, um eine proportionale Vertretung der Parteien, d. h. der von den Parteien ausgewählten Funktionäre und Kandidaten, egal ob Frauen oder Männer, in den politischen Organen zu erreichen.
lsp.judge: Ms. Karamanou, I do not believe that the weak representation of women or young people in our parliaments is due to an excess of democracy, but rather to a democracy deficit, and the candidate lists compiled by the parties - which, as you recommend in your report, are even compiled as lists with a quota regulation, where it is no longer even possible to cast a preferential vote - form an excellent system for achieving proportional representation of the parties, i.e. the party-selected officials and candidates, regardless of whether they are women or men, in the political bodies.

lsp.query: Die doppelte Belastung durch familiäre Pflichten und Berufstätigkeit kann man meiner Meinung nach nicht als Diskriminierung bezeichnen, und sie ist auch kein zweifacher Nachteil wie in Erwägungsgrund D dargestellt. Familie und Beruf miteinander verbinden zu können, stellt eher ein hohes Maß an Organisationstalent und eine nicht zu unterschätzende Lebenserfahrung dar, die als besondere Qualifikation für Führungspersönlichkeiten gewertet werden muss.
lsp.judge: In my opinion, the double burden of family obligations and professional activity cannot be described as discrimination, nor is it a double disadvantage as presented in point D. Being able to combine family and work represents a high degree of organizational talent and a significant life experience that must be valued as a special qualification for leadership positions.

lsp.query: - (FR) Obwohl alle einhellig die hohe Zahl von Unfällen im Straßenverkehr in den verschiedenen europäischen Mitgliedstaaten verurteilen, kann sich die EDD-Fraktion nicht vollständig mit dem Bericht von Frau Hedkvist Petersen über die Mittel, wie dem abzuhelfen ist, einverstanden erklären. Die Lösung kann nicht lauten: immer mehr Europa, immer mehr Geld, immer mehr Repression.
lsp.judge: Although everyone unanimously condemns the high number of accidents on the roads in the various European member states, the EDD group cannot fully agree with Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen's report on the means to address this issue. The solution cannot be: more Europe, more money, more repression.
lsp.proxy: - (FR) Although everyone unanimously condemns the high number of road accidents in the various European member states, the EDD group cannot fully agree with Ms. Hedkvist Petersen's report on the means to remedy this. The solution cannot be: more and more Europe, more and more money, more and more repression.
lsp.reference:
# English
- (FR) Although all unanimously condemn the high number of accidents in road traffic in various European member states, the EDD faction cannot fully agree with Mrs. Hedkvist Petersen's report on the means to help alleviate the situation. The solution cannot be: more and more Europe, more and more money, more and more repression.

lsp.query: Eine Reform der Schulung (beispielsweise Verkehrserziehung bereits in der Schule und Schulung in Notbremsung in der Fahrschule), die Systematisierung der aktiven und passiven Sicherheitselemente auch in einfachen Kraftfahrzeugen durch steuerliche Anreize für die Hersteller oder die Veränderung der Infrastrukturen, indem die "Unfallschwerpunkte " völlig beseitigt werden, das sind die echten Herausforderungen einer intelligenten Politik der Straßenverkehrssicherheit.
lsp.judge: A reform of training (for example, traffic education already in school and training in emergency braking in driving school), the systematization of active and passive safety elements also in simple vehicles through tax incentives for manufacturers or the modification of infrastructure by completely eliminating "accident hotspots", these are the real challenges of a smart road safety policy.
lsp.proxy: A reform of training (for example, traffic education already in school and training in emergency braking in driving school), the systematization of active and passive safety elements also in simple motor vehicles through tax incentives for manufacturers or the modification of infrastructures by completely eliminating "accident hotspots", these are the real challenges of an intelligent road traffic safety policy.
lsp.reference: A reform of training (for example, traffic education already in school and training in emergency braking in driving school), the systematization of active and passive safety elements also in simple vehicles through fiscal incentives for manufacturers or the change of infrastructure by completely eliminating the "accident hotspots", these are the real challenges of an intelligent policy of road safety.

lsp.query: Diese Problematik ist für den Alpenbereich - und ich komme ja aus dem Alpenbereich - und vor allem in Bezug auf die Alpentransversale München-Verona von ganz besonderer Bedeutung, und wir hoffen, dass sich die Kommission durch das neuerliche Votum, das das Parlament hier zum Ausdruck gebracht hat, veranlasst sieht, die entsprechenden Vorbereitungsarbeiten noch zu beschleunigen und mit viel größerer Konzentration und Stärke voranzutreiben, als es bisher erfolgt ist, damit dieses dringende Problem im Alpenbereich einer Lösung zugeführt werden kann.
lsp.judge: This issue is of particular importance for the Alpine region - and I come from the Alpine region - and especially in relation to the Alpine Transversal Munich-Verona. We hope that the Commission, spurred on by the renewed vote expressed by Parliament here, will see fit to accelerate the relevant preparatory work and drive it forward with much greater concentration and strength than has been the case so far, so that this urgent problem in the Alpine region can be solved.

lsp.query: Lino Miserotti sagte zu mir: "Ich als Rentner finde es richtig, dass ich für die Benutzung dieser Autobahn eine Maut bezahlen muss, denn so leiste ich einen Beitrag zum Bau und zur Unterhaltung von Autobahnen, die eine wichtige Verkehrsinfrastruktur darstellen. Doch es wäre gut, wenn die Arbeitnehmer, die einer Arbeit nachgehen und sich noch nicht im Ruhestand befinden, von der Gebührenzahlung befreit würden. "
lsp.judge: Lino Miserotti said to me: "As a retiree, I think it's right that I have to pay a toll for using this highway, because that way I contribute to the construction and maintenance of highways, which are an important part of the transportation infrastructure. But it would be good if workers who are still working and not yet retired were exempt from paying the toll."

lsp.query: Aus diesen Gründen kann ich, obwohl ich für viele Änderungsanträge der Fraktion der Grünen/Freie Europäische Allianz, in denen konkrete Maßnahmen gefordert werden, Verständnis habe, diese hier nicht unterstützen, da sie den Konsens in den vorstehend genannten Prinzipien gefährden würden. Sie können später im Verlauf der Umsetzung eines Gebührenrahmens geprüft werden.
lsp.judge: For these reasons, although I understand the many amendment proposals from the Green/Free European Alliance faction, which call for concrete measures, I cannot support them here, as they would jeopardize the consensus on the aforementioned principles. They can be examined later in the course of implementing a fee framework.

lsp.query: Wenn der Kraftstoffpreis schwindelerregend hoch ist und das Fünf- bis Sechsfache dessen beträgt, was das Benzin beim Verlassen der Raffinerie kostet, weil er sich zu mehr als 80 % aus Steuern zusammensetzt, so kann man wohl sagen, dass der Straßennutzer, gemessen an der Nutzung seines Fahrzeugs, bereits in hohem Maße dafür zur Kasse gebeten wird, dass er öffentliche Straßeninfrastrukturen nutzt.
lsp.judge: When the fuel price is exorbitantly high and is five to six times what gasoline costs leaving the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can safely say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already being heavily charged for using public road infrastructure.
lsp.proxy: When the fuel price is dizzyingly high and is five to six times what the gasoline costs when leaving the refinery, because it consists of more than 80% taxes, one can well say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already being asked to pay a high price for using public road infrastructure.
lsp.reference: If the fuel price is dizzyingly high and is five to six times that of gasoline when it leaves the refinery, because it is composed of more than 80% taxes, then one can say that the road user, measured by the use of his vehicle, is already being asked for a high amount to use public street infrastructure.

lsp.query: Für uns sollte dies Anlass ein, unsere Stimme zu erheben, um diese Machenschaften Russlands gegenüber seinem ehemaligen Vasallen zu verurteilen, und durch konkretes Handeln zur politischen Stabilisierung dieser Region und ihrem ökonomischen Aufschwung beizutragen. Und dann sollten wir, wie in der Entschließung vorgeschlagen, einen Sondergesandten für den Südkaukasus benennen, denn ein Flächenbrand im Südkaukasus würde auch Europa nicht verschonen.
lsp.judge: For us, this should be an occasion to raise our voices to condemn these machinations of Russia against its former vassal, and to contribute through concrete action to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing. And then, as proposed in the resolution, we should appoint a special envoy for the South Caucasus, because a wildfire in the South Caucasus would not spare Europe either.
lsp.proxy: For us, this should be an occasion to raise our voice to condemn Russia's machinations against its former vassal, and through concrete action, contribute to the political stabilization of this region and its economic upswing. lsp.query: Unsere Bitte an die Kommission ist deshalb, zusammen mit dem Rat zu überlegen, ob wir diese Konfliktfälle nicht besser aufarbeiten und darangehen sollten, mit Entscheidungen, die in die richtige Richtung gehen, den Menschen dort, die eine demokratische Gesellschaft aufbauen wollen und friedliche Zukunftsvisionen brauchen, zu helfen und Georgien zu unterstützen, damit es die Menschenrechte einhalten und den übrigen im Europarat eingegangenen Verpflichtungen nachkommen kann.
lsp.judge: Therefore, our request to the Commission is to consider, together with the Council, whether we should not better address these conflict cases and proceed with decisions that go in the right direction, helping the people there who want to build a democratic society and need peaceful visions for the future, and supporting Georgia so that it can uphold human rights and comply with the other commitments it has made to the Council of Europe.
lsp.proxy: Our request to the Commission is therefore to consider, together with the Council, whether we should not better address these conflict cases and take decisions that go in the right direction to help the people there who want to build a democratic society and need peaceful visions for the future, and to support Georgia so that it can uphold human rights and comply with the other commitments it has entered into in the Council of Europe.
lsp.reference: Our request to the Commission is therefore to consider together with the Council whether we should not better process these conflict cases and proceed with decisions that are heading in the right direction, to help the people there who want to build a democratic society and need peaceful visions of the future, and to support Georgia so that it can uphold human rights and fulfill the other obligations it has entered into within the Council of Europe.

ilsp.query: Im vorliegenden Fall geht es um die Politik eines großen Nahrungsmittelkonzerns, der Umsätze erzielt hat, die selbst der Konzernchef als hervorragend bezeichnet, und zur gleichen Zeit den Beschluss fasst, 3 000 Stellen zu streichen und mehrere Werke in einigen Mitgliedstaaten der Europäischen Union zu schließen.
ilsp.judge: In this case, it concerns the policy of a large food conglomerate that has generated sales that even the CEO describes as excellent, and at the same time decides to cut 3,000 jobs and close several plants in several member states of the European Union.

ilsp.query: Frau Präsidentin! Wie schon mehrere Male zuvor und in meinen mehrfachen Schreiben an Sie zum Ausdruck gebracht, möchte ich auch mit meiner heutigen Wortmeldung darauf hinweisen, dass in der Türkei seit dem 20. Oktober, also seit Monaten, Hunderte unter menschenunwürdigen Bedingungen lebende politische Gefangene in einem Hungerstreik stehen, wobei sie auch den Tod in Kauf nehmen - einige von ihnen sind bereits gestorben -, damit die türkische Regierung ihr Vorhaben, sie in weiße Einzelzellen zu sperren und dadurch ihre Moral und ihren Widerstand zu brechen, nicht verwirklichen kann.
ilsp.judge: Madam President! As I have already expressed several times before and in my numerous letters to you, I would also like to point out with my statement today that for months, since October 20th, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions in Turkey have been on hunger strike, even accepting death - some of them have already died - so that the Turkish government cannot carry out its plan to lock them up in white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and their resistance.
ilsp.proxy: Madam President! As I have already expressed several times before and in my multiple letters to you, I would also like to point out with my statement today that in Turkey, since October 20th, thus for months, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on a hunger strike, accepting the risk of death - some of them have already died - so that the Turkish government cannot realize its plan to lock them in white single cells and thereby break their morale and resistance.
ilsp.reference: Madam President! As I have already expressed on several occasions and in my multiple written submissions to you, I would like to draw your attention once again today to the fact that in Turkey, hundreds of political prisoners living under inhumane conditions have been on hunger strike since October 20, putting their lives at risk - some of them have already died - in order to prevent the Turkish government from carrying out its plan to imprison them in white solitary cells and thereby break their morale and their resistance.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, ich gratuliere Frau de Veyrac zu ihrer engagierten Erarbeitung des Themas "Übereinkommen zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union ", denn mit ihrem Bericht wird unterstrichen, wie unerlässlich ein nachhaltiges Eintreten Europas für diese so wichtige Frage ist und welcher Maßnahmen es zudem weltweit bedarf.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, I congratulate Ms. de Veyrac on her dedicated work on the topic "Agreement for the Protection of World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union," because her report highlights how essential it is for Europe to take a sustainable stance on this important issue and what measures are also needed worldwide.
ilsp.proxy: Mr President, I would like to congratulate Mrs de Veyrac on her committed work on the subject of the "Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union", because her report highlights how essential it is for Europe to take a sustainable stance on this important issue and what measures are also needed worldwide.
ilsp.reference: Mr. President, I congratulate Mrs. de Veyrac on her dedicated work on the topic "Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union", as her report underscores the importance of Europe's sustainable commitment to this crucial issue and the need for further measures worldwide.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte darauf verweisen, und das wird auch in dem Bericht anerkannt, dass in fünf Bereichen - Rechnungsabschluss, Institutionelle Probleme hinsichtlich Verwaltung und Kontrolle, Büros für Technische Hilfe, partnerschaftlich durchgeführte Verwaltung der Gemeinschaftspolitiken und Bekämpfung von Betrug und Korruption - zwar Fortschritte erzielt worden sind, gleichwohl aber noch eine Menge aufzuarbeiten bleibt.
ilsp.judge: I would like to point out, and this is also acknowledged in the report, that while progress has been made in five areas - closing accounts, institutional problems regarding administration and control, technical assistance offices, partnership-based administration of common policies, and combating fraud and corruption - there is still a lot of work to be done.

ilsp.query: Erwiesenermaßen war es richtig, das Büro in Thessaloniki zu belassen, denn hätten wir es nach Pristina ausgelagert, hätte Jugoslawien heute keinerlei Aussicht auf eine finanzielle Unterstützung durch die Agentur für Wiederaufbau, denn kein Serbe könnte jemals nach Pristina reisen, um dort auch nur einen Euro einzufordern.
ilsp.judge: It was proven right to keep the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had moved it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no chance of receiving financial support from the Reconstruction Agency, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even one euro.
ilsp.proxy: It has proven to be correct to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had outsourced it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Reconstruction Agency today, because no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to demand even one euro there.
ilsp.reference: It was undoubtedly the right decision to leave the office in Thessaloniki, because if we had relocated it to Pristina, Yugoslavia would have no prospect of financial support from the Reconstruction Agency, since no Serb could ever travel to Pristina to claim even a single euro.

ilsp.query: Die tiefgreifende politische Umgestaltung der Strukturen der bundesdeutschen Regierung ist ein deutliches Signal dafür, dass es selbst im Herzen Europas, wo die GAP entworfen wurde und wo sie stets ihre große Stütze fand, immer unhaltbarer ist, ein Modell einer Agrarpolitik aufrecht zu erhalten, das zur Bewahrung des industriellen Systems und der großen landwirtschaftlichen Betriebe konzipiert wurde.
ilsp.judge: The profound political reshaping of the structures of the German government is a clear signal that even in the heart of Europe, where the CAP was designed and where it has always found its strong support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises.
ilsp.proxy: The profound political restructuring of the structures of the West German government is a clear signal that even in the heart of Europe, where the CAP was designed and where it has always found its greatest support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy designed to preserve the industrial system and large agricultural enterprises.
ilsp.reference: The far-reaching political restructuring of the federal government's structures is a clear indication that even at the heart of Europe, where the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) was designed and where it has always found its strong support, it is becoming increasingly unsustainable to maintain a model of agricultural policy that was conceived to preserve the industrial system and large-scale agricultural enterprises.

ilsp.query: Wir müssen begreifen, dass die Zeiten, in denen ein Arbeitsplatz ein ganzes Leben lang hielt, heute vorbei sind; dass neue Arbeitsmöglichkeiten erdacht werden müssen und dass der KMU- und der Handwerkssektor unseren Jugendlichen und den Unionsbürgern in Zukunft immer mehr reale Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten bieten werden.
ilsp.judge: We must understand that the times when a job lasted a lifetime are over today; that new job opportunities must be conceived and that the SME and crafts sector will offer our young people and Union citizens more real employment opportunities in the future.
ilsp.proxy: We must understand that the times when a job lasted a whole lifetime are over; that new job opportunities must be invented and that the SME and craft sector will offer our young people and Union citizens more and more real job opportunities in the future.
ilsp.reference: We must understand that the times when a job would last a whole lifetime are over; that new job opportunities need to be created and that the SME and crafts sector will offer our young people and Union citizens more and more real job opportunities in the future.

ilsp.query: (ES) Meine Zustimmung zum Bericht de Veyrac über die Umsetzung des Übereinkommens zum Schutz des Kultur- und Naturerbes der Welt in den Staaten der Europäischen Union basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass es notwendig ist, die kulturelle Dimension der Europäischen Union weiterzuentwickeln und eine Kulturpolitik in der Union zu gewährleisten, die als eines der Hauptmerkmale ihres geistigen Reichtums und des Alten Kontinents die kulturelle, sprachliche, architektonische und künstlerische Vielfalt sowie alle jene Elemente zum Tragen bringt, die unser gemeinsames kulturelles Erbe darstellen.
ilsp.judge: My consent to the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage in the European Union member states is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main features of its intellectual wealth and of the Old Continent, brings to bear the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity as well as all those elements that constitute our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.proxy: (ES) My approval of the de Veyrac report on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main features of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, brings to bear the cultural, linguistic, architectural and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our common cultural heritage.
ilsp.reference: My consent to the report by de Veyrac on the implementation of the Convention for the Protection of the World's Cultural and Natural Heritage in the Member States of the European Union is based on the conviction that it is necessary to further develop the cultural dimension of the European Union and to ensure a cultural policy in the Union that, as one of the main characteristics of its spiritual wealth and the Old Continent, encompasses the cultural, linguistic, architectural, and artistic diversity, as well as all those elements that represent our shared cultural heritage.

ilsp.query: Die Vertreter der einen möchten das gesamte System mit allen seinen Grundlagen der bisherigen und gegenwärtigen gemeinsamen Fischereipolitik auf den Prüfstand stellen, während die anderen, ohne seine Grundlagen grundsätzlich in Frage zu stellen, das System präzisieren, verändern, verbessern wollen, damit der Fischereisektor sich, natürlich im Einklang und unter Erhalt der Fischereiressourcen, weiter entwickelt.
ilsp.judge: Representatives of one group want to put the entire system, with all its foundations of past and present common fisheries policy, to the test, while the others, without fundamentally questioning its foundations, want to refine, change, and improve the system so that the fishing sector can continue to develop, of course in harmony and with the preservation of fishing resources.
ilsp.proxy: The representatives of one group want to put the entire system, with all its foundations of the previous and current common fisheries policy, to the test, while the others, without fundamentally questioning its foundations, want to specify, change, and improve the system, so that the fisheries sector can continue to develop, naturally in harmony and while preserving the fisheries resources.
ilsp.reference: The representatives of one group want to put the entire system, including all its foundations of the current and previous common fisheries policy, to the test, while the others, without fundamentally questioning its foundations, want to refine, change, and improve the system so that the fisheries sector can continue to develop, naturally in harmony and while preserving the fisheries resources.

ilsp.query: Nichtsdestotrotz spüre ich eine gewisse Zuversicht und stelle fest, dass die EU-Staaten unkoordiniert angetreten sind - Herr Brok hat soeben davon gesprochen -, um die Anerkennung des stalinistischen Regimes von Pjöngjang zu wetteifern, wobei sie die Augen vor den Geschehnissen innerhalb des Landes, vor den dramatischen Menschenrechtsverletzungen, verschließen.
ilsp.judge: Nevertheless, I feel a certain optimism and note that the EU states have entered the race for recognition of the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang uncoordinated - Mr. Brok has just spoken about this - while closing their eyes to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights violations.
ilsp.proxy: Despite this, I sense a certain degree of confidence and note that the EU states have approached uncoordinatedly - Mr Brok has just spoken about this - to compete for recognition of the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while closing their eyes to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights violations.
ilsp.reference: Despite this, I sense a certain optimism and I note that the EU member states have embarked on this uncoordinated - as Mr. Brok has just mentioned - competition to recognize the Stalinist regime in Pyongyang, while turning a blind eye to the events within the country, to the dramatic human rights abuses.
