ilsp.query: Wenn es lediglich darum gegangen wäre, zu überwachen, dass die EU-Mittel nicht zur Finanzierung von Projekten verwendet werden, die zur Zerstörung dieser besonderen Ökosysteme beitragen, so hätte ich diesen Text akzeptiert und dafür gestimmt, aber es ist inakzeptabel und beispiellos, dass eine Unionspolitik von der Einhaltung einer anderen abhängig gemacht wird und dass ein Umweltkriterium beispielsweise gegenüber einem sozialen Kriterium Vorrang haben soll.
ilsp.judge: If it had only been about monitoring that EU funds were not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these special ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that Union policy is made dependent on compliance with another, and that an environmental criterion should take precedence over a social criterion, for example.
ilsp.proxy: If it were merely a matter of monitoring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these special ecosystems, I would have accepted and voted for this text, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that a Union policy is made dependent on compliance with another and that an environmental criterion, for example, is given priority over a social criterion.
ilsp.reference: If it had merely been a matter of ensuring that EU funds are not used to finance projects that contribute to the destruction of these unique ecosystems, I would have accepted this text and voted for it, but it is unacceptable and unprecedented that a Union policy is made dependent on the observance of another and that an environmental criterion should take precedence over a social criterion, for example.

ilsp.query: Was den Wunsch nach Verzicht auf eine geographische Begrenzung für diese schnelle Eingreiftruppe anbelangt, so erinnert dies an die Raubzüge der früheren Kolonialmächte in Afrika und anderswo, wie sie etwa von Frankreich begangen wurden, um vom Volk abgelehnte Diktatoren zu schützen, oder wie sie derzeit von Großbritannien in Sierra Leone durchgeführt werden.
ilsp.judge: As for the desire to waive a geographical limitation for this rapid reaction force, this recalls the raids of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those carried out by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as they are currently being carried out by Britain in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.proxy: As for the desire to waive geographical restrictions for this rapid intervention force, this is reminiscent of the raids of former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or as currently being carried out by Great Britain in Sierra Leone.
ilsp.reference: As for the desire to forgo geographical limitations for this rapid intervention force, this recalls the raids of the former colonial powers in Africa and elsewhere, such as those committed by France to protect dictators rejected by the people, or those currently being carried out by the United Kingdom in Sierra Leone.

ilsp.query: Der von mir bereits erwähnte Beschluss besagt, dass ein Bürger eines EU-Mitgliedstaates, der sich um konsularische Hilfe an eine diplomatische oder konsularische Vertretung eines anderen Mitgliedstaates wendet, so zu behandeln ist, als wäre er Bürger des Landes, das durch die betreffende Botschaft oder das Konsulat vertreten wird.
ilsp.judge: The resolution I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state shall be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate in question.
ilsp.proxy: The decision I have already mentioned states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular mission of another member state is to be treated as if he were a citizen of the country represented by the embassy or consulate in question.
ilsp.reference: The decision I mentioned earlier states that a citizen of an EU member state who seeks consular assistance from a diplomatic or consular representation of another member state is to be treated as if they were a citizen of the country represented by the relevant embassy or consulate.

ilsp.query: Der Rat begrüßt außerdem die Tatsache, dass sich die EU und die ASEAN in ihrer in Vientiane beschlossenen gemeinsamen Erklärung verpflichten, die Bemühungen des Sonderbeauftragten des UNO-Generalsekretärs für Birma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, um eine positive Entwicklung in Burma zu unterstützen.
ilsp.judge: The Council also welcomes the fact that the EU and ASEAN, in their joint declaration adopted in Vientiane, commit to supporting the efforts of the UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy for Burma, Tan Sri Razali Ismail, to promote a positive development in Burma.

ilsp.query: Meines Erachtens wird hierdurch deutlich, dass die Verkehrssicherheit nicht mit herausgegriffenen Einzelmaßnahmen im erforderlichen Maße erhöht werden kann, sondern dass dies nur durch einen ganzen Komplex von Maßnahmen machbar ist, und dazu gehören Verkehrserziehung, Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, Alkoholbegrenzung, besserer Straßenausbau, Verkehrsleitsysteme, erhöhter Sicherheitsstandard der Fahrzeuge, stärkere Kontrollen der Einhaltung der Straßenverkehrsordnung und auch eine permanente Begutachtung der Fahrzeuge, die sich im Straßenverkehr befinden.
ilsp.judge: In my opinion, this clearly shows that road safety cannot be sufficiently increased by isolated measures, but only by a comprehensive package of measures, which include traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, improved road construction, traffic management systems, higher safety standards for vehicles, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles on the road.
ilsp.proxy: In my opinion, this makes it clear that road safety cannot be sufficiently increased by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive package of measures, which includes traffic education, speed limits, alcohol limits, improved road construction, traffic guidance systems, a higher safety standard for vehicles, stricter controls on compliance with the road traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles in road traffic.
ilsp.reference: In my opinion, it becomes clear that road safety cannot be increased to the required extent by isolated individual measures, but rather that this can only be achieved through a comprehensive set of measures, including traffic education, speed limits, alcohol restrictions, improved road infrastructure, traffic management systems, enhanced vehicle safety standards, stricter enforcement of traffic regulations, and also a permanent inspection of vehicles that are in operation on the roads.

ilsp.query: Ich möchte dem Kollegen Paolo Costa ein großes Lob aussprechen, nachdem wir uns jahrelang in diesem Hause sehr heftig über die Frage gestritten haben, was der richtige Weg zur Anlastung von Wegekosten ist. Es ist ihm gelungen, mit seinem Bericht einen breiten Konsens zu erreichen.
ilsp.judge: I would like to express my sincere appreciation to colleague Paolo Costa. After years of heated debate in this house about the best way to alleviate travel expenses, he has succeeded in achieving broad consensus with his report.
ilsp.proxy: I would like to pay a great tribute to my colleague Paolo Costa, after we have argued very fiercely in this House for years about the right way to charge infrastructure costs. He has managed to achieve a broad consensus with his report.
ilsp.reference: I would like to express great praise to my colleague Paolo Costa, after we have been fiercely debating the question of how to properly charge road costs for years in this house. He has managed to achieve a broad consensus with his report.

ilsp.query: Jene, die darauf setzen, dass die formelle Gleichstellung, der Faktor Zeit und die selbstregulierenden Mechanismen quasi von selbst ein soziales Gleichgewicht herstellen, irren. Sicher sind die Gleichstellung vor dem Gesetz und die Chancengleichheit unerlässliche Voraussetzungen, doch dabei dürfen wir es nicht belassen.
ilsp.judge: Those who rely on the formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms to essentially create a social balance on their own are mistaken.  While equality before the law and equal opportunities are indispensable prerequisites, we must not stop there.
ilsp.proxy: Those who rely on formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms to more or less automatically establish social equilibrium are mistaken. Certainly, equality before the law and equal opportunities are essential prerequisites, but we must not stop there.
ilsp.reference: Those who believe that formal equality, the factor of time, and self-regulating mechanisms will automatically establish a social equilibrium are mistaken. While legal equality and equal opportunities are essential prerequisites, we must not stop there.

ilsp.query: Herr Präsident, die Älteren unter uns haben die außergewöhnlichen, grauenhaften Berichte, die 1975 aus Kambodscha kamen, noch nicht vergessen. Es gab Luftaufnahmen von einer verlassenen Hauptstadt, weil die Roten Khmer, deren Anführer nach den Lehrsätzen der Gewalt in der Tradition der französischen Revolution geschult wurden und von einer Mischung aus politischem Idealismus und Massenpsychopathologie erfüllt waren, zwei Millionen Menschen von der Stadt auf das Land umsiedelten, um unter der Führung des "großen " Pol Pot im Jahre Null mit einer neuen Gesellschaft zu beginnen.
ilsp.judge: Mr. President, those of us who are older still remember the extraordinary, horrifying reports that came out of Cambodia in 1975. There were aerial photographs of an abandoned capital city because the Khmer Rouge, whose leader was trained in the doctrines of violence in the tradition of the French Revolution and filled with a mixture of political idealism and mass psychopathology, had relocated two million people from the city to the countryside to begin a new society under the leadership of the "great" Pol Pot in Year Zero.
ilsp.proxy: Mr. President, the older among us have not yet forgotten the extraordinary, horrific reports that came from Cambodia in 1975.
